jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT CIM GROUP:**

CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today!

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

We are seeking an experienced Project Coordinator to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing business needs, documenting business requirements, writing test cases and creating process flows. The Project Coordinator will assist with project management tasks, such as drafting comprehensive project plans, overseeing budget allocations, and ensuring adherence to timelines.

The ideal candidate is a quick learner who will learn the intricacies of business processes across CIM and understand their impact on strategic projects. This role requires a proactive individual to coordinate the efforts of internal and external team members to deliver projects according to plan.

This role also requires someone who is comfortable switching between business analysis and project management duties, as may be required by project needs. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of PMO and Business Operations.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Business Analysis:

* Work with business owners and stakeholders to understand their business processes. Identify process improvement opportunities.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, process flows and future state requirements. Write and manage test cases that trace back to business requirements.
* Support change management efforts, including training and adoption planning.
* Facilitate end-user testing and ensure deliverables meet quality standards.
* Serve as a liaison between business units and technical teams to ensure alignment and clarity.

General Analytics:

* Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions. Proactively review data and identify & recommend opportunities.
* Problem-Solving: Apply analytical thinking to solve complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Requirements Gathering: Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable project plans.

Documentation:

* Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain thorough project documentation, including project charters, requirements documents, and user manuals.
* Process Documentation: Document business processes and workflows to ensure clarity and consistency across the organization. Helps design, document and maintain system processes as needed.
* Meeting Minutes: Record detailed meeting minutes and action items to ensure accountability and follow-up.
* Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations for stakeholders, summarizing project progress, risks, and recommendations.

### **EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: (including certification, licenses, etc.)**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in business analyst or project management, preferably in investment management, private equity, financial services or consulting. Must have contributed to the execution of multiple projects from inception to implementation.
* Active or pursuing Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or PMI-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis) or similar.
* Familiarity with Waterfall, hybrid & Agile /Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday, etc.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (incl. Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables etc.)) and Visio.
* Experience with AI tools such as Copilot and Claude in a workplace setting.

Preferred qualifications:

* Treasury and Cash: Finance background with working knowledge of treasury and cash processes, such as cash positioning, payments (ACH, wire, and virtual card), bank reconciliation, and payment fraud controls.
* Experience with Yardi or another real estate ERP, or with AP automation and outsourced payment programs.

### **ABOUT YOU:**

* Strong relationship building and influencing skills. Excellent written and verbal communication, along with strong interpersonal skills.
* Proven experience in eliciting business requirements and documentation with minimal supervision.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to handle ambiguity and influence others to achieve common goals.

**WHAT CIM OFFERS:**

At CIM, we believe our success stems from our collective efforts, and we are committed to providing well-rounded support and resources for our employees. In addition to a competitive compensation plan, CIM offers a comprehensive benefits program for employees to thrive both inside and outside of work. Eligible employees can enjoy a wide range of benefits, including:

* A variety of Medical, dental, and vision benefit plans
* Health Savings Account with a generous employer contribution
* Company paid life and disability insurance
* 401(k) savings plan, with company match
* Comprehensive paid time off, including: vacation days, 10 designated holidays, sick time, and bereavement leave
* Up to 16 hours of volunteer time off
* Up to 16 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
* Ongoing professional development programs
* Wellness program, including month

The Acquisition Security Program Specialist Journeyman provides directorate-level security support for all assigned personnel and assists in the management of SATCOM & PNT Acquisition Systems Program Security including Personnel Security, Industrial Security, Operations Security, Information Security, Communications Security, and Physical Security.

* Manage and implement the directorate OPSEC Policy and verify OPSEC is incorporated into organizational plans, exercises, and activities IAW DoDD 5205.02E, AFI 10-701 and assist OPSEC Coordinators in the overall management of OPSEC Program.
* Plan, coordinate and conduct OPSEC assessments annually and report findings IAW DoDD 5205.02E, AFI 10-701
* Accomplish and verify end-of-day security checks for classified rooms and containers.
* Coordinates security efforts among the SATCOM & PNT programs and facilitates support to program managers and material leadership.

* Conduct secure equipment device management (e.g., secure telephone and encryption devices) and classified keying material inventories, inspections, and other COMSEC-related support and oversight functions
* Perform installation, troubleshooting, and support of secure communications devices and coordinate to deliver encryption device(s) and keying material to select Information Technology (IT) specialists maintaining classified networks
* Administer a Top-Secret inventory and document control program to account for classified holdings, COMSEC equipment, and materials
* Conduct inventories per agency policy and reports any discrepancy to government customer
* Manage accountability of classified courier authorizations and provide training to classified couriers on responsibilities for the protection of classified information and author receipts for classified materials
* Ensure Automated Information Systems Security requirements, related to COMSEC duties, are complied with
* Ensure proper physical security accreditation has been issued by designated Program Security Officers for supported facilities
* Train personnel in COMSEC and SVRO procedures and the use of related equipment
* Develops tracking metrics to capture recurring and ad-hoc security tasks and brief status to government security personnel
* Participates in program IPT meetings to garner insight into program security requirements and works directly with program managers to ensure programmatic requirements are met

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Gaining Early Awareness and Readiness for Undergraduate Programs (GEAR UP) strives to increase the number of underrepresented students from low-income backgrounds who enter and succeed in postsecondary education.

Under the supervision of the GEAR UP Director, the Program Coordinator will lead in the development, coordination, implementation, documentation, and evaluation of comprehensive services and activities for program participants to meet GEAR UP Grant Objectives. The Program Coordinator serves as a primary liaison between the Project Director and designated partner school site(s), overseeing academic advising, tutoring, college and career readiness, student and family engagement, and enrichment opportunities. The position works collaboratively with school districts, administrators, participant families, teachers, university partners, community organizations, and GEAR UP staff to advance program objectives and ensure compliance with grant requirements.

This position will require travel between the CSUF campus, designated school sites, and other partner locations. Some early morning, evening, weekend, and overnight work will be required.

* *Please be aware that funding for this position is awarded through a Grant/Contract over a specified period. Employment for this position beyond current Grant/Contract funding is contingent upon continued funding.*

**Essential Duties**
--------------------

**Program Planning and Implementation:**

* Lead the planning, development, coordination, implementation, and evaluation of GEAR UP programs and activities, including workshops, field trips, campus tours, GEAR UP Academies, special events, and enrichment opportunities for students and families.
* Manage an assigned participant caseload ranging from 200 to 500 program participants and provide timely advising to support participants’ academic progress, college and career exploration, and postsecondary goals.

**Program Participant Advising and Academic Support:**

* Provide individual and group advising to students on academic progress, postsecondary planning, college and career exploration, college and career selection, applications, scholarships, and financial aid.
* Coordinate tutoring, mentoring, referrals, parent/guardian advisement, and other academic support services as needed.

**Program Participant Success Planning:**

* Develop, monitor, and update Individual Academic/Success Plans in collaboration with students, parents/guardians, and/or school personnel.
* Conduct periodic grade and participation reviews, identify barriers to student success, and connect participants with appropriate resources and support services.

**School and Community Partnerships:**

* Serve as a liaison between the Project Director and designated school sites.
* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with school administrators, teachers, counselors, district personnel, university partners, community organizations, parents/guardians, and other stakeholders to support program objectives.

**Staff Supervision and Development:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, mentor, and schedule GEAR UP staff, student ambassadors, graduate assistants, mentors, and other assigned personnel.
* Support staff development, consistent service delivery, and compliance with program policies and procedures.
* Track and report staff payroll and effort certifications as assigned.

**Program Documentation and Data Management:**

* Maintain organized, accurate, and confidential participant records, program files, attendance, participation, demographic data, service documentation, curriculum, and other records using established systems and in accordance with grant requirements and program policies.

**Budget and Grant Compliance:**

* Assist in planning and reviewing budget allocations and expenditures for staffing, materials, events, and program initiatives.
* Oversee the collection, valuation, documentation, and reporting of in-kind cost-match contributions to support compliance with U.S. Department of Education grant requirements.

**Program Evaluation and Reporting:**

* Monitor program implementation and progress toward grant objectives and established benchmarks.
* Assist with preparing annual performance reports, evaluations, assessments, and periodic updates for internal use, CSUF, the U.S. Department of Education, and other project stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate and secure program records, protect confidential student information, and follow established policies and procedures when accessing, storing, and sharing data.

**Participant Recruitment and Engagement:**

* Coordinate participant recruitment, retention, and family engagement efforts to increase participation in GEAR UP services.
* Develop and implement outreach strategies to raise awareness of program opportunities and foster a college-going culture.

**Communications and Program Promotion:**

* Assist in developing and distributing GEAR UP websites, social media content, brochures, flyers, posters, presentations, and other informational materials to increase program visibility across CSUF, partner schools, and community audiences.

**Representation and Collaboration:**

* Represent GEAR UP and CSUF at school sites, community events, meetings, trainings, and other professional settings.
* Support cross-campus collaborations and partnerships that expand educational opportunities for program participants.

**Travel and Additional Responsibilities:**

* Travel regularly to assigned school sites, partner locations, meetings, and professional development trainings.
* Participate in and support training opportunities that strengthen staff knowledge, skills, and program implementation.
* School and site assignments may change based on program needs and the discretion of the Project Director.

**Other duties:**

* Other duties as assigned.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Marketing & Communications Coordinator

Location: Los Angeles, CA / Hybrid

FLSA Status: Full-time, Non-Exempt

Reports to: Development Manager

Salary/ Compensation: $28-30/hr.

Effective: 11/13/2026

POSITION SUMMARY

The Marketing & Communications Coordinator supports Safe Parking LA’s mission by producing clear, timely, and mission-aligned communications across digital, print, email, social media, website, donor-facing, and public-facing channels. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing day-to-day communications work while taking ownership of specific communications and marketing projects, such as impact reports, newsletters, social media initiatives, and marketing campaigns. This position manages timelines, tracks deliverables, and ensures projects move forward in alignment with department priorities.

Serves as the intake point for media inquiries: acknowledges receipt, gathers details, and routes each one to the Executive Director or Director of Development, who serve as spokesperson.

This position is well-suited for a strong writer and content producer who can manage multiple projects, stay organized, and take ownership of assigned communications initiatives while supporting fundraising, community engagement, and organizational visibility.

WHAT YOUR DAYS CONSIST OF

Content Production and Digital Communications (35%)

* Draft, edit, schedule, and publish content across social media, email, website, and other digital platforms.
* Maintain and update website content to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Support email marketing production, including formatting, list coordination, testing, scheduling, and basic performance tracking.
* Create and adapt content for different audiences, including donors, volunteers, community partners, and the general public.
* Maintain the communications calendar and coordinate timelines to ensure content is reviewed and published on schedule.
* Track basic engagement metrics and share insights with the Development Manager.

Project Coordination and Initiative Ownership (35%)

* Take ownership of assigned communications and marketing projects.
* Coordinate project timelines, tasks, and deliverables to ensure work is completed on schedule within scope and budget.
* Track progress across projects and follow up with internal contributors as needed.
* Ensure materials are reviewed, approved, and finalized before publication.
* Identify potential delays or gaps and communicate proactively with the Development Manager.
* Maintain organized project files, templates, and documentation for recurring communications efforts.

Design, Storytelling, and Brand Consistency (20%)

* Design graphics and materials for digital and print use, including social media assets, flyers, donor materials, and event collateral.
* Maintain visual and messaging consistency across all communications in adherence to brand identity and guidelines.
* Gather and organize photos, stories, testimonials, and other content assets in coordination with program and development staff.
* Support development of donor-facing materials such as appeals, stewardship pieces, reports, and presentations.
* Ensure all communications embody ethical storytelling and reflect participant dignity, accuracy, and SPLA’s mission and values.

Media and Public Inquiry Coordination (10%)

* Monitor and respond to incoming media inquiries as the first point of contact, acknowledging receipt, and gathering key details.
* Screen inquiries for relevance and urgency and escalate to appropriate leadership for response.
* Coordinate approved media engagements, including scheduling, logistics, and adherence to protocols.
* Maintain records of media inquiries and outcomes.
* Monitor public-facing comments and escalate sensitive or high-risk issues.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Communications projects are completed on time and meet established expectations.
* Assigned campaigns, newsletters, and initiatives are well-coordinated and executed with minimal oversight.
* Communications are accurate, timely, and aligned with organizational priorities.
* Website, email, and social media content are current, consistent, and professionally executed.
* Campaign and event communications support fundraising and engagement goals.
* Media inquiries are handled promptly and escalated appropriately.
* Content assets and project materials are organized and accessible.
* Communications contribute to increased visibility, engagement, and donor support.

QUALIFICATIONS

* At least two years of experience in marketing, communications, digital media, or a related field.
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Experience with social media, email marketing, website updates, and content scheduling.
* Basic graphic design skills and experience creating digital or print materials.
* Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, email marketing platforms, website CMS, and social media platforms.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned projects and follow through to completion.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and escalate sensitive issues appropriately.
* Ability to work independently while following established processes.
* Experience with nonprofit or mission-driven communications preferred.
* Ability to travel to program sites and events in Los Angeles County (mileage reimbursed under SPLA policy).
* Ability to work on occasional evenings and weekends.
* Commitment to Safe Parking LA’s mission and values.

Helps facilitate information maintenance and distribution by learning and drafting routine and standard presentations, correspondence, and reports. Organizes workflow by following detailed instructions in the identification and assistance of the resolution of routine requests from front-line teams and department managers on an ad-hoc basis. Assists with event coordination by beginning to coordinate and calendar meetings for directors and their direct teams, with guidance from senior colleagues. Assists with event execution by arranging small-scale events with detailed instructions and monitoring from senior colleagues. Learns to execute data maintenance and management by developing basic knowledge of department data and documentation retention policies.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
  

  
* Works with others within work team to obtain and share basic information. Listens and addresses performance feedback; provides feedback to team members. Learns new relevant knowledge and skills; acknowledges strengths and weaknesses based on career goals and takes action to leverage / improve them. Adapts to change, challenges, and feedback with moderate guidance. Responds to the needs of others to support completion of routine work tasks.
  
* Follows detailed, daily instructions to complete routine tasks with moderate supervision. Collaborates with others within ones team to address routine and some non-routine task issues; communicates status and escalates more complex issues. Adheres to established priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies and speaks up for improvement opportunities within ones team.
  
* Helps facilitate information dissemination by: learning and drafting routine and standard presentations, handouts, reports/spreadsheets, graphics, status reports, resource management reports, and other deliverables based on a working knowledge of business practices/process, with detailed direction from senior colleagues with minimal interpretation; writing correspondence (e.g., letters, reports, confidential documents) to staff and managers, with moderate guidance from senior colleagues; and following broad guidance labeling, sorting, and maintaining the integrity of department files.
  
* Organizes the work flow of the department by: following detailed instructions in the identification and assistance of the resolution of routine requests from front-line teams and department managers on an ad-hoc basis; learning about potential problems and typical routes for resolution, with detailed instruction; operating standard office equipment (e.g., email, fax, xerox), with specific goals and moderate guidance; maintaining routine inventory control and stocking department office supplies, equipment, and employee work environment resources (e.g., space assignment, computer) and may escalate inventory issues; and receiving, screening, and referring straightforward incoming and outgoing mail, emails, calls, and visits to the appropriate staff member by following broad guidance.

jobs.title: B2B Sales Representative – Wholesale & Retail Accounts
jobs.description:

We specialize in toys, novelties, seasonal merchandise, and impulse products, working with retailers to develop product assortments and programs tailored to their customers.

The ideal candidate is commercially minded, enjoys building relationships with retail buyers, understands consumer product trends, and can independently manage sales opportunities from initial prospecting through purchase orders and ongoing account growth.

A key focus of this position will be expanding PPNC's presence within **grocery, value, specialty, convenience, drug, and other retail channels**, while supporting and growing existing customer relationships.

**This is a business-to-business (B2B) sales position focused on corporate retail buyers and wholesale accounts, not an in-store retail sales role.**

Key Responsibilities

**Business Development & Sales Growth**

* Identify, prospect, and develop new retail and wholesale business opportunities.
* Establish relationships with retail buyers, category managers, purchasing teams, and key decision-makers.
* Expand PPNC's presence across grocery, value, specialty, convenience, drug, and other retail channels.
* Conduct outbound prospecting through email, phone, LinkedIn, trade shows, and referrals.
* Present product assortments, seasonal programs, and merchandising opportunities to prospective customers.
* Drive sales growth by converting qualified opportunities into purchase orders.

**Retail Account Management**

* Manage assigned retail accounts and serve as the primary customer contact.

* Identify opportunities for additional product placements, seasonal programs, reorders, and expanded distribution.

**Product Trends & Customer Development**

* Research emerging trends in toys, novelties, collectibles, sensory products, and seasonal merchandise.
* Monitor competitive products, retail assortments, pricing, packaging, and consumer preferences.
* Collaborate with design and product development teams to create customer-specific product assortments and programs.
* Translate customer feedback and market opportunities into actionable product recommendations.
* Prepare and coordinate product presentations, pricing proposals, samples, and sales materials.

**Sales Execution & Account Coordination**

* Review purchase orders for product, pricing, quantity, and delivery accuracy.
* Coordinate with operations, logistics, design, and production teams to support customer requirements.

Qualifications

* **3+ years of experience** in B2B sales, wholesale distribution, account management, business development, or consumer products preferred.

* Ability to independently develop new business while managing existing accounts.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customers, deadlines, and projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and related business tools.
* Experience using Monday.com, CRM platforms, or sales management systems is a plus.

What Makes You Successful

* You are proactive and motivated to generate new business.
* You enjoy building long-term relationships with retail buyers.
* You understand how to present products and convert opportunities into sales.
* You take ownership of accounts, customer commitments, and deadlines.
* You can balance new business development with ongoing account management.
* You recognize sales opportunities through product trends, available inventory, and customer needs.
* You collaborate effectively with internal teams to deliver results.

Why Join PPNC?

This is an opportunity to build a career in consumer-product sales while gaining direct experience with established and emerging retail accounts.

You will work closely with our Sales Director and internal product, design, and operations teams to introduce exciting products to the marketplace, develop meaningful retail partnerships, and contribute directly to the company's growth.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world's first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.  
  
Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a **Recruiting Coordinator**, reporting to the **Senior Manager, Talent Operations**, to bring precision and care to how we coordinate interviewing across the company. You run interview scheduling and logistics across our open roles, working side by side with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to keep our process moving.

The Recruiting Coordinator will hold themselves at a high bar, with sharp attention to detail protecting the candidate experience every step of the way.

This will be a **full-time**, **non-exempt (fixed-term for 6 months)** position located onsite at our **Long Beach** location.

* Run interview scheduling and onsite logistics across our open roles, including multi-round and panel interviews.
* Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to keep scheduling and onsite logistics running smoothly, clear roadblocks as they come up, and build the relationships that keep our process moving.
* Help document and maintain our coordination processes, and keep them current as we grow.
* Flag friction in how we coordinate and suggest improvements.
* Take on additional projects and tasks as needed to support the broader talent operations team.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years in recruiting coordination or a comparable administrative role
* Hands-on experience with an applicant tracking system, Greenhouse preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes, accountability, and continuous improvement

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Comfort navigating ambiguity and building without a fully defined playbook
* Experience in a fast-paced start-up or corporate environment
* Strong customer service mindset

*We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.*

The Disney Entertainment segment is home to the company’s portfolio of world-class studios and television businesses worldwide, including Disney+, our flagship streaming platform. The Digital Center of Excellence (COE) houses a cross-functional team dedicated to creative strategy, content planning/execution, and digital and creator campaign management for all studio brands, including Disney, Disney+, Disney Studios, Walt Disney Animation Studios, Pixar, Marvel, Lucasfilm, 20th Century, and Searchlight and Television IP (Disney Family & Kids, Freeform, Hulu, and Nat Geo)

**Job Summary:**

The Manager, Digital Marketing – is a key operational role supporting the creator, social, and YouTube content pipelines for Disney+ Verts, the short-form vertical content experience on mobile. The ideal candidate will serve as the day-to-day operational support across the internal Digital Marketing teams (Social, Creator, and Marketing Operations), working alongside teams across all content groups. This individual will coordinate, track, and manage digital assets across creator, social, and YouTube pipelines, tailored for vertical video, short-form, and long-form formats, ensuring that creative assets meet business and brand goals and are delivered on time according to project milestones.

You will collaborate closely with the internal teams, along with legal and clearances and marketing leads, to identify content opportunities, source creative, help clear content for service, and manage the lifecycle of assets, building and maintaining workflows across the content pipelines for sustainment and global growth, while helping the teams scale volume efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Cross-Studio Collaboration & Content Sourcing:** Act as the operational connection between the internal Social, Creator, and Marketing Operations teams, legal and clearances, and marketing teams, aligning on content needs, execution, and delivery of assets for the programming initiative.

* **Campaign & Asset Management:** Lead the planning and execution of creator, social, and YouTube assets, including vertical and short-form content for on-platform use, through final delivery, ensuring assets are intended for fan engagement and retention in alignment with platform and brand strategies.

* **Marketing Operations Support:** Partner with the Marketing Operations team to ensure assets are trafficked, tracked, and delivered in line with established technical specifications, naming conventions, and handoff requirements, escalating spec or platform questions to the appropriate team leads as needed.

* **Stakeholder Communication:** Coordinate across the internal Social, Creator, YouTube, and Ops teams, providing regular status updates, managing feedback loops, and driving timely resolution of blockers.

* **Workflow & Process Optimization**: Maintain and improve content intake, sourcing, and delivery processes, utilizing tools such as Airtable to track asset lifecycle, surface bottlenecks, and ensure project timelines are met.

* **Industry & Platform Trends:** Stay up-to-date on creator, social, YouTube, and vertical/short-form content trends, emerging platforms, user behaviors, and digital best practices, sharing relevant insights with the teams to inform execution.

* **Brand Stewardship:** Ensure all content aligns delivered to Disney+ adheres to company standards for quality, innovation, and brand safety.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years digital marketing and/or digital content management within consumer-facing media or entertainment.

Elite Home Staging is the **third-largest home-staging company in Southern California**, with more than **200 homes across the Los Angeles market**. This is a highly relationship-driven sales position. You will be responsible for building a strong network within the real estate community, identifying potential clients, developing relationships, following up consistently, and converting opportunities into new staging business.

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.

jobs.description:
**SAMBAZON, named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces for 2025, is seeking a** **Customer Operations Coordinator** **to join our Logistics & Customer Operations team immediately.**

**About the Role**

The Customer Operations Coordinator plays a key role in supporting SAMBAZON’s business-to-business customers by managing orders from entry through delivery. This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in customer service, order management, and logistics.

The role works closely with grocery retailers, foodservice partners, and internal cross-functional teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.

***This is a full-time role is based on-site in our San Clemente office and offers $25.00 per hour, a generous benefits package, annual bonus opportunity, and half-day Fridays.***

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Process customer orders, including order entry and invoicing, using systems such as SAP, EDI and web-based warehouse systems
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries related to pricing, product information, order status, shipment updates, and issue resolution
* Communicate regularly with buyers, brokers, and sales teams to support order management, deliveries, and customer needs
* Communicate order fulfillment status, delays, and service issues to internal teams including Supply Planning, Logistics Management, Sales, and Customer Operations
* Perform administrative tasks including invoice approvals, maintaining various department documents and files as well as other related tasks
* Assist in resolving order, shipping, and delivery issues in a timely and professional manner
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in customer service, logistics, order management, or a related field
* Associate degree or higher preferred
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills across all levels of an organization
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail, particularly in data entry and order processing
* Experience with SAP, EDI, or similar systems preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Bilingual skills are a plus

**About SAMBAZON:**

Founded in 2000, SAMBAZON is the pioneer of organic Amazon Superfoods, fresh juices, smoothies, energy drinks, and frozen products made from delicious blends of handpicked Brazilian fruits and plants such as açaí (ah-sigh-ee), acerola, and guarana. SAMBAZON is committed to sharing superfoods with the world in a way that consciously benefits people and planet. Our certified organic, fair trade and non-GMO Project verified partnership helps protect the Amazon rainforest and benefits thousands of family farmers, while bringing consumers next level superfood nutrition. SAMBAZON is widely available in 20-plus countries.

All SAMBAZON products are made from USDA Organic, Non-GMO, vegan, Fair for Life, Fair Trade Certified açaí. SAMBAZON’s Fair Trade certification has helped to protect the Amazon Rainforest and its rich biodiversity and has positively impacted thousands of local growers.

With the commitment to invest a percentage of local açaí purchases back into the community, SAMBAZON has contributed over $1 million to build healthcare centers, community centers and schools. For more information about SAMBAZON’s mission and products, visit www.sambazon.com.

*SAMBAZON is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

CityTeam is a Christian non-profit dedicated to supporting communities by meeting immediate needs and enabling lasting solutions for those struggling with poverty, homelessness, and addiction. Being part of CityTeam is not just a career but a calling. As ministerial representatives on the frontlines of our organization, we feel privileged to use our education, experience, and gifts to love people and bring glory to God.

A ministerial worker must be a Christ-centered individual who is active in a faith-based community, well-versed in Scripture, and passionate about helping clients grow in their relationship with Christ. In this dual role of spiritual guide and program manager, the worker provides spiritual direction, administrative oversight, and direct logistical coordination for individuals participating in our faith-based residential and recovery programs. The expectation for this role is that your daily life will serve as a living testimony to our program participants.

This is a Christian environment that values Teamwork, Accountability, Humility, Innovation, and Joy.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Mancini's Sleepworld**
------------------------------

Mancini's Sleepworld is Northern California's hometown mattress retailer, with 60+ showrooms across the Bay Area, Sacramento, the Central Valley, and the Central Coast. We're family-rooted, locally known, and growing fast, including welcoming Christian's Mattress Xpress showrooms to the family. Our marketing team runs everything from broadcast, streaming, and outdoor to search, social, and in-store promotions, and we're building a smarter, more content-driven marketing organization to support the next phase of growth.

**The role**
------------

**Marketing** at Mancini's moves fast: a new promotion every few weeks, TV and radio across five markets, new showrooms opening, and dozens of partners to keep in sync. The Marketing Coordinator is the person who makes sure it all gets where it needs to go, on time and correct.

You'll keep our promotional calendar running, make sure 60+ showrooms have the right materials for every sale event, get our TV and radio spots to stations with the right instructions, and keep projects moving between marketing, sales, and the rest of the business.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

*Promotions & store support*

* Serve as the central ordering point for store point-of-purchase (POP) materials, including window signs, A-frames, table tents, hanging signs, SEG frames, feather flags, and partner displays, working with print vendors from order through delivery.
* Make sure every showroom has the right promotional materials in place before each sale event, on deadline.
* Keep the promotional calendar up to date and run the checklist for each sale event: signage, pricing collateral, store communication, and launch timing.
* Write and send marketing communications to store teams so every showroom knows what is running, when, and how to talk about it.
* Support new store openings, store transitions, and rebrands, including grand opening kits, signage, and local events.
* Coordinate promotional updates to the website and email with the e-commerce team so every channel matches the current offer.

*TV & radio trafficking*

* Traffic TV, streaming, and radio spots to stations and partners: traffic instructions, rotations, Ad-ID/ISCI codes, and delivery deadlines.
* Update trafficking instructions quickly when promotions change, so the right message is on air for every sale weekend.
* Confirm receipt and on-air start with stations, catch and fix errors, and keep a clean spot library and rotation log by market and promotion.

*Events & community*

* Plan and coordinate community activations and sponsorships, such as high school sports events, including materials, giveaways, staffing, and logistics.
* Support company and partner events, including internal events, vendor events, and sports partnership activations.

*Project coordination & marketing operations*

* Keep account access, documentation, and naming conventions organized so history and assets are easy to find.
* Track spend against budget and pacing, including vendor co-op funds and the documentation needed for reimbursement.
* Work directly with Google and Meta account reps.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 1–3 years of experience in marketing coordination, retail marketing, agency account coordination, or broadcast traffic.
* Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented; you catch the wrong date, code, or price before it goes out.
* Able to manage many deadlines at once and follow up until work is done.
* Clear, friendly communicator in writing and in person with store teams, vendors, and agencies.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and Excel/Google Sheets; experience with a project management tool such as Monday.com, Asana, or Trello.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

*Preferred*

* Experience trafficking TV or radio spots, or working at a station, agency, or media company.
* Multi-location retail or home furnishings experience.
* Experience with vendor co-op advertising programs.
* Basic Canva or Adobe skills for quick resizes and store communications.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

**Timeframe**

**What success looks like**

First 30 days

Trafficking and promo calendar handed off with no missed spots or late store materials; knows key contacts at stations, agencies, print vendors, and stores.

60 days

Running the full checklist for a sale event; POP ordering, trafficking log, and spot library up to date; Monday.com boards current.

90 days

Running promotions and trafficking independently; co-op documentation and invoice tracking current; first process improvement proposed.

*Ongoing KPIs: on-time spot delivery and zero trafficking errors, on-time store materials for each event, project timelines met, co-op claims submitted on time, and internal partner satisfaction.*

**Work Environment**

In office at our Livermore corporate office Monday through Thursday; remote on Fridays. Occasional travel to our showrooms as needed.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative

* Driven & Curious: You’re energized by goals, love learning, and always seek better ways to connect with people

* Organized & Adaptable: You’re able to juggle multiple priorities, manage a high volume of conversations, and keep your pipeline moving—even in a fast-changing environment
* Collaborative & Coachable: You welcome feedback, enjoy working with cross-functional teams, and are always open to growth

* Comfortable with AI: You enjoy testing and applying AI tools to improve performance and are open to evolving how you work with new technology

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in or deep understanding of the health & fitness industry

**Why Join Everfit**

* Help shape how millions of people discover and connect with fitness coaches
* Work with autonomy and ownership on high-impact projects
* Join a collaborative, global team with experience from leading tech and fitness companies
* Enjoy competitive salary, equity, and performance bonuses

If you’re ready to build the future of fitness and wellness experiences, let’s talk!

Retail has become a content business, and this is the person who will tell the Mancini's Sleepworld story every day. You'll own our organic social presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn: what we post, why, how often, and how well it performs.

You'll turn everything happening across 60+ showrooms into content: store openings, our San Francisco Giants partnership, community events, vendor launches, our team, and our customers. You'll also work with our influencer lead to bring creator and customer content into the feed, so the brand shows up in more voices than our own.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

*Strategy & editorial planning*

* Build and own the organic social strategy, content pillars, and monthly editorial calendar, aligned to the retail promo calendar and brand campaigns.
* Plan channel-specific content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn, and evaluate new platforms as they emerge.
* Plan always-on and tentpole content moments: Sleep Awareness Month, holiday sale events, Giants season, store grand openings, and community partnerships.
* Bring Luna and other brand characters to life on social in line with brand standards.

*Content creation & capture*

* Shoot, edit, and publish short-form video, photography, and stories, often on a phone, in showrooms and at events.
* Write captions and copy in the Mancini's voice; adapt campaign creative from the creative team and agency for each platform.
* Manage freelance video editors and videographers (including Upwork talent): briefs, a reusable footage library, turnaround times, and quality.
* Plan content coverage for community activations and sponsorships, such as high school sports events, so every event becomes social content.
* Brief the creative team (and, as the Content Studio grows, the Multimedia Content Producer) on bigger content needs.
* Follow each mattress brand's guidelines on co-branded content (Tempur-Pedic, Casper, Aireloom, and others), including approvals.

*Creators, influencers & UGC*

* Partner with our Influencer & Creator Lead on the always-on creator program across our creator verticals (moving & new homes, bedroom design, sleep health & recovery, couples & family, performance & wellness).
* Own the organic side of creator content: asset handoffs, cross-posting and collabs, content tracking, and usage-rights and whitelisting expiration dates.
* Support vendor-funded creator programs (Casper, Aireloom, Avocado, and others) so content meets each brand's guidelines and Mancini's can reuse it.
* Build an employee-generated content program that helps store teams share their stories, with simple guidelines and training.
* Collect and secure rights to customer content and reviews for organic and paid use.

*Community management*

* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, mentions, and reviews on a defined service standard, routing customer service issues to the right team.
* Spot reputation issues early and escalate them to the Director of Marketing with a recommended response.
* Support store-level community engagement: local partners, schools, sports sponsorships, and events.

*Measurement & partnership with paid*

* Report monthly on reach, engagement, video views, creator performance, and social-driven traffic, with clear recommendations for what to do next.
* Plan post boosting around promo windows with the Senior Paid Media Buyer, share top organic and creator content for whitelisting, and use paid results to inform what gets made next.
* Track social listening and competitor activity (including Mattress Firm) and bring insights back to the team.
* Manage the social tool stack (e.g., Sprout Social), content library, and approval workflows in Monday.com.

**Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**About Stuut**
===============

Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.

Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.

Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai.

**Sales Development Lead**

The Sales Development Manager will partner with the Head of Business Development to build and coach the team that opens every door for us. You'll help hire, coach, and run our Business Development Representatives, whose job is to qualify and convert leads for our Account Executives' calendars.

You'll spend most of your day on the floor ,listening to calls, running huddles, coaching reps in the moment. This role will report to the SDR Manager

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the team's weekly and monthly qualified-meeting targets, show rates, and meeting-to-close contribution.
* Assist with Recruiting, interviewing, and ramping BDRs on an aggressive growth plan.
* Coach daily. Live call listening, recorded call reviews, role plays, and one-on-ones with clear development plans for every rep.
* Partner with the Head of Business Development for daily operating cadence — morning huddles, activity tracking, end-of-day reviews — and hold the team to high standards on volume, speed-to-lead, and CRM hygiene.
* Report clearly to the Head of Business Development on pipeline created, team performance, and what's working or not.

**Qualifications**

We care about how you lead as much as what you've done. The ideal candidate has carried a phone quota, then built and coached a team that beat one.

**Required**

* 1+ years in sales
* 1+ year managing or leading SDRs, BDRs, or an inside sales team.
* A track record of hitting team targets through coaching and process.
* Experience hiring, onboarding, and ramping early-career salespeople at pace.
* Strong command of outbound and inbound prospecting mechanics: cadences, speed-to-lead, qualification, disposition discipline.
* Fluent with CRM systems, dialers, and sales engagement tools; comfortable building reports and reading a dashboard.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You coach, you don't just manage. Your reps get measurably better every month, and they can tell you exactly what you're working on with them.
* You're on the floor. You lead from the middle of the room, not from a conference call.
* You're competitive. You keep score for the team and you take a miss personally.
* You're resilient. Early-career reps struggle, quit, and surprise you. You reset and keep the standard high.
* You're a teammate. You want the AEs to win as much as your own team, and you build that into how SDRs work.
* You take ownership. The team's number is your number.

**Nice to Have**

* Competitive background, you've been coached hard and you know how to coach.
* Experience in high-velocity consumer sales (education, youth programs, fitness, coaching, insurance, or similar).
* Experience standing up an SDR team from a small group to a large one.

* Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)

**About the Opportunity**

**JOB SUMMARY**

  

The Faculty Operations Coordinator is part of a shared services model established to provide consistent, campus-wide administrative, operational, and experiential learning support to Oakland faculty. Serving all colleges represented on the Oakland campus and more than 150 faculty members across six campus buildings, this position functions as a central resource designed to grow alongside the campus. The position reports to the Associate Dean of Academic Programs.

The Faculty Operations Coordinator works with a high level of autonomy, initiative, and discretion to support the day-to-day operational needs of faculty. The incumbent is expected to exercise independent judgment within assigned areas of responsibility, proactively identify and address needs before they become problems, and lay the groundwork for a shared services model that will expand over time. As the program grows, this role may take on supervisory responsibilities.

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

Bachelor's degree required. 2-3 years experience in education administration, operations, event management, or a related field. Demonstrated experience supporting faculty and leaders in a complex, service-oriented environment a plus.

Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including exceptional writing and proofreading abilities. High proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. Proven ability to work effectively with a diverse population of students, faculty, staff, and community partners.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, exercises sound judgment and discretion, builds productive relationships across stakeholder groups, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities. Experience overseeing staff or student employees and supporting complex events or campus initiatives is a plus.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

Administrative & Classroom Support

* Manage supply inventory, ordering, and distribution; ensure supply closets and printer paper are consistently stocked across campus buildings
* Coordinate mail distribution and monitor facilities needs, escalating and following through on issues with appropriate contacts

* Assist faculty with reimbursements and provide Workday onboarding support for student research assistants

* Print and prepare classroom materials as requested by faculty

* Lead faculty onboarding for new and incoming faculty members, ensuring a consistent and well-coordinated experience
* Manage space allocation for faculty across the campus, including hoteling desks and shared workspaces
Serve as the primary resource and escalation point for Faculty Leads requiring additional administrative support  

Experiential Learning Support

* Coordinate faculty experiential learning requirements with the Director, Experiential Learning and campus operations team, including logistics with speakers, partners, and other campus guests; responsibilities may include drafting MOUs, managing transportation, and serving as a liaison with campus partners

Coordinate with campus teams to support faculty events.  



Faculty Support Operations & Demand Management

* Serve as the primary intake point for faculty support requests across all Oakland colleges, establishing a consistent and transparent process for receiving, triaging, and responding to needs

* Develop and maintain systems and workflows to manage the volume and variety of faculty support demand on a fast-paced, multi-college campus, ensuring requests are prioritized and addressed efficiently

* Build and refine operational infrastructure for the shared services model, including tools, tracking, communication protocols, and service standards, with an eye toward scalability as the program grows

* Proactively identify patterns in faculty need and surface opportunities to improve service delivery, reduce friction, and better support the academic mission of the campus

* Maintain clear and consistent communication with Faculty Leads and the Academic Programs and Operations team regarding service capacity, priorities, and status of ongoing requests

Plan and support campus Faculty events.  



General Administrative Duties

* Coordinate, schedule, and provide day-to-day oversight of undergraduate and graduate student assistants as needed; support onboarding in Workday and manage task assignments, time, and payroll

* Maintain current knowledge of university policies, regulations, and procedures; ensure compliance within assigned areas

* Serve as a working resource for Workday, Microsoft 365, and other HR, finance, and purchasing platforms

Perform other related duties as assigned

**Job Description**

The New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA)’s Office of Resident Economic Empowerment & Sustainability (REES), situated within NYCHA’s Department of Resident Services, Partnerships, and Initiatives (RSPI), is charged with working to develop, and implement programs, policies, and collaborations to measurably support residents increased economic opportunities with a focus on asset building, employment, advancement, adult education and training, and business development.
  
  
NYCHA has implemented a Zone Model approach, which leverages NYCHA’s and partner resources to expand economic opportunity for public housing residents through place-based service coordination. Through this approach, REES enables NYCHA to (1) Generate more economic opportunities for NYCHA residents and NYCHA neighborhoods, while strategically investing and leveraging NYCHA’s spend; (2) Provide a more comprehensive economic empowerment platform with additional capacities around financial literacy, asset building and business development; (3) Reduce the duplication of services – better investing limited resources; (4) Enable NYCHA to be a better partner to community-based organizations, government agencies, philanthropies, community colleges, schools, employers and other key stakeholders; and (5) Drive more resources and investment into public housing neighborhoods.
  
  
NYCHA REES seeks a dynamic Project Coordinator to join its Job Generation team. The Job Generation Unit supports NYCHA vendors and other employer partners with resident hiring, job training, and other economic opportunities in connection with Section 3 and other NYCHA hiring commitments. The team engages NYCHA residents, Resident Leaders and other internal and external stakeholders-connecting interested residents to upcoming Section 3 and other economic opportunities. The Project Coordinator will report to the unit Supervisor.

1. With oversight, perform critical functions for the Job Generation unit to ensure review and feedback of NYCHA partner resident hiring and other economic opportunities plans that prioritize NYCHA resident hiring.

8. Work closely with any interns assigned to the Job Generation unit.
  
9. Responsible for administrative duties associated with core functions such as updating spreadsheets, scanning, answering phone calls, filing and other related duties.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
1. NYCHA employees applying for transfer, promotional, title or level change opportunities must have served a period of one year at current location and in current title and level (if applicable).

Job Summary

A&O Construction Company is seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Construction Project Coordinator to support the planning, scheduling, and execution of construction projects. The successful candidate will coordinate project activities, maintain documentation, communicate with contractors and suppliers, monitor deadlines, and assist project managers in ensuring that work progresses efficiently and according to project requirements.

* Track project milestones, deadlines, and outstanding assignments.
* Assist with preparing progress reports, meeting notes, and project updates.
* Coordinate site meetings, inspections, and contractor appointments.
* Monitor material orders and follow up on delivery schedules.
* Help identify scheduling conflicts and communicate potential project delays.
* Support compliance with project specifications and company procedures.

* Associate or bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Previous construction or project coordination experience is an advantage.
* Knowledge of construction processes and project documentation.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

* Construction project scheduling and coordination.
* Contractor and vendor communication.
* Project documentation and reporting.
* Material procurement and delivery tracking.
* Budget and expense recordkeeping.
* Team collaboration and task management.
* Familiarity with construction project management tools.

With additional experience and professional development, employees may pursue advancement into senior project coordination, assistant project management, construction operations management, or construction project management roles.

Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.  
  
**About the Role:**  

We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Media Coordinator to support the day-to-day media operations of Complex’s post-production department.

This role will assist with media ingest, organization, asset management, archival, and editorial support across multiple productions. Working closely with the Post Operations Supervisor, the Media Coordinator will help maintain organized media workflows, ensure footage and project assets are properly tracked, and support editors and producers throughout the post-production process.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced production environment, has a strong understanding of post-production workflows, and is proactive about maintaining organized, accessible media across shared storage systems.

  

**Working Days & Hours**

Monday through Friday

### **What You'll Do**

#### **Media Ingest & Organization**

* Ingest, verify, label, and organize footage and production assets for editorial teams.
* Maintain consistent folder structures, naming conventions, and media organization standards across projects.
* Coordinate with production and studio teams to ensure footage and supporting assets are properly received and accounted for.
* Maintain accurate media ingest records and documentation to support asset tracking and handoffs.
* Assist with preparing and transferring media for editors, producers, and other internal teams.

#### **Media Asset Management & Archival**

* Support the organization and maintenance of media across on-premises servers and cloud-based storage platforms.
* Assist with maintaining media asset management systems, including Iconik collections, metadata, and asset organization.
* Support project archival and restoration workflows in accordance with established company retention policies.
* Help ensure completed projects, source media, and final deliverables are properly organized and archived.
* Assist with locating and retrieving archived media for editorial and production requests.
* Editorial & Post-Production Support
* Support editors with project setup, media organization, relinking, and asset preparation.
* Create stringouts, selects, and basic assemblies for producer and editorial review.
* Export still images, reference files, and other assets for internal teams, including design, editorial, and social.
* Assist with media transfers and preparation of assets for internal and freelance editors.
* Help troubleshoot routine media-related issues and escalate technical concerns when necessary.

#### **Workflow Tracking & Operational Support**

* Maintain and update internal tracking systems, including Airtable, for media ingest, project status, and archival.
* Assist with tracking media requests, asset transfers, and post-production handoffs.
* Help maintain documentation of post-production workflows and operational procedures.
* Communicate proactively with editors, producers, and production teams regarding media availability, organization, and outstanding requests.
* Support the Associate Director of Post and Post Operations Supervisor in maintaining efficient and consistent day-to-day workflows.

### **Who You Are**

* Familiarity with post-production workflows, media ingest, and editorial environments.
* Experience organizing and managing digital media assets.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across production, editorial, and technical teams.
* Experience with production tracking tools such as Airtable.
* Familiarity with shared storage environments, network-attached storage (NAS), and file management workflows.
* Experience with media asset management platforms such as iconik and cloud storage systems such as AWS S3 is strongly preferred.
* Ability to follow established workflows while proactively identifying organizational or technical issues.

### **Key Platforms and Tools Used**

* Adobe Premiere Pro / Adobe Creative Cloud
* Iconik
* Airtable
* Media Shuttle
* Frame.io
* Shared network storage / NAS
* Cloud storage platforms (AWS S3 or similar)

This role requires a publishing professional who is detail-oriented, fastidious in nature, creative and eager to find outside-the-box ways to promote our books but also comfortable using data analysis, all with an eye on making sure our books are best positioned for maximum success in the marketplace.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Develop and execute marketing campaigns across digital, retail, and social channels for a robust audiobook list with occasional print publications.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

**The Administrative Coordinator provides program administration, participant records, attendance tracking, data management and reporting support for TCAH’s Workforce Development Department, working closely with program leadership, the Case Worker, the Job Developer, instructors and worksite supervisors. This is an administrative and compliance support role; it does not include case management, eligibility determinations or independent approval authority.**

**TCAP / Venture VI is the primary assignment (approximately 70% of workload), with ongoing YEP support (approximately 30%), including Green Teens, Green Teens Workforce, Culinary Arts and Warehouse training. Percentages are approximate annual allocations and may shift with seasonal demand, including the summer SYEP peak, and approved funding.**

**Responsibilities**

**1. Program Administration & Coordination**

* **Maintain program calendars, staff and training schedules, participant appointments and room or site reservations.**
* **Prepare agendas, sign-in sheets, correspondence and forms; record meeting notes and track action items.**
* **Coordinate logistics for orientations, workshops, trainings and hiring events; route calls, referrals and inquiries to appropriate staff.**

**2. Participant Records & File Management**

* **Schedule intake appointments, prepare packets, and collect, scan and log participant documents for Case Worker verification.**
* **Maintain complete, confidential electronic and paper files, rosters, cohort lists and exit records, shared only with authorized staff.**
* **Review files at least monthly for missing signatures, incomplete fields or expired documents and notify the assigned Case Worker.**

**3. Attendance, Data Entry & Quality Review**

* **Enter attendance and countable participation hours from source records supplied by training and worksite supervisors; flag missing or inconsistent records.**
* **Enter and update participant, service and outcome data in Salesforce and other approved systems, using source data from the Case Worker and Job Developer.**
* **Run routine quality checks for missing, duplicate or inconsistent entries and return discrepancies to the original author; gather hours and wage documents for Payroll/Accounting.**

**4. Reporting, Deadlines & Compliance Support**

* **Track and issue alerts for 30-day SNAP eligibility verification, consent renewals and 30- and 90-day retention milestones.**
* **Prepare the weekly operations dashboard and compile data for monthly KPI, quarterly and annual program reports.**
* **Organize employment verification, supportive service and reimbursement documentation for review, monitoring and audits; flag incomplete records or potential duplicate assistance.**

**5. TCAP and YEP Program Coverage**

* **TCAP / Venture VI (approximately 70%): maintain referral logs, enrollment documents, rosters, attendance, hours and retention trackers; schedule orientations, workshops, training and employer events; check employment start documentation for completeness.**
* **YEP (approximately 30%): maintain rosters, attendance and training-progress records for youth ages 14–24 and prepare YEP performance data.**
* **Seasonal SYEP: support rosters, hours, outcome records, closeout and youth event logistics (scheduled and evaluated separately from the annual allocation).**

**6. Communication & Collaboration**

* **Work with program leadership, the Case Worker, Job Developer, instructors, Benefits Access, Finance, Contracts and Compliance; refer case management or eligibility questions to appropriate staff.**
* **Route payroll, reimbursements, supportive services and record corrections to designated approvers; accuracy of case content remains with its author.**
* **Attend staff meetings and trainings, and perform other related administrative duties as assigned.**

**Qualifications**

* **High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in business administration, office administration, human services or a related field preferred. Degree preferred.**
* **At least two years of administrative, program coordination, data entry or office support experience; nonprofit, workforce or social services experience preferred.**
* **Strong organization, attention to detail and written and verbal communication skills; ability to handle confidential information responsibly.**
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); Google Workspace and Salesforce or other CRM experience preferred.**
* **Familiarity with DYCD, WIOA, SNAP E&T, OTDA or HRA requirements, and additional language skills relevant to TCAH communities, preferred.**

**Schedule and Working Conditions**

**Full-time, primarily on-site at assigned TCAH locations and partner sites, with occasional evening or weekend work for program activities and events. Summer months may bring additional workload from seasonal youth programs. Any overtime for nonexempt staff requires advance approval; all hours worked must be recorded and paid as required by law.**

**Performance Expectations**

**Performance will be reviewed against monthly file reviews, with missing or expired items flagged within 2 business days; at least 95% data-entry accuracy on supervisor spot checks; attendance and hours entered within 2 business days, and other data within 3 business days, of receipt; deadline alerts issued at least 7 days before each due date; on-time weekly dashboard and report data; records organized for monitoring and audits; and administrative effort tracked across TCAP and YEP (approximately 70% / 30%).**

jobs.description:
#### **About the Role**

At Xtremepush, we enable companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships by delivering exceptional technology, expertise, and customer service. As a leading provider of customer engagement solutions, our mission is to empower businesses to create meaningful, personalised experiences for their audiences.  
  
Due to rapid growth, we’re seeking an Account Manager to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be pivotal in fostering long-term, trusted partnerships with some of our most valuable customers. By driving revenue retention and growth through relationship building, cross-selling, and upselling, you’ll directly contribute to our company’s success.  
  
As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers achieve exceptional outcomes through our platform. By leveraging your expertise and interpersonal skills, you’ll help them realise the full value of their investment, fostering product adoption, expansion, and retention.  
  
This is a hybrid role (East Coast timezone). #LI-Remote

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Account Management & Relationship Development:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all customer account management matters for assigned accounts.
* Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships, checking in frequently and regularly with clients.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with clients to review performance, discuss strategic goals, and align on upcoming initiatives.
* Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors

* Identify and pitch cross-sell and upsell opportunities to drive revenue growth.
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximise profits.
