* Ensure meticulous and regular tracking and updating of all tasks, client interactions and progress within HubSpot.
* Clearly communicate the progress of monthly and quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare detailed reports on account status.

**Client Partnership:**

* Resolve conflicts and provide solutions to customers in a timely manner.
* Escalate complex client requests or issues as necessary.
* Act as the voice of the customer within Xtremepush, ensuring their needs and feedback are effectively communicated and addressed.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of customer strategies.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.

#### **Your Experience and Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in an Account Manager, Customer Success Manager or relevant role
* Have at least 5 years experience in a tech / SaaS company.
* Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation, including executive and C-level
* Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs
* Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
* Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation abilities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Familiar with SaaS customer management or have a background in data with a flair for client communication and understand consumer behaviour is desirable
* Additional language is desirable

#### **Location**

This is a hybrid role based in the US (East Coast). #LI-Remote

#### **About us**

Headquartered in Ireland with offices in the UK and US, Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built-in CDP. It enables high-velocity companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships through personalised, relevant, and timely communication. With a true single customer view at its core, Xtremepush provides actionable customer intelligence that drives engagement, conversion, and revenue across all channels, while putting customer retention first.

We don’t just accept differences, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our mission by ensuring that our place can be anyone’s place regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.*

jobs.title: Account Manager - NY (PST)
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

New York, NY (hybrid, Pacific time hours) | Full-time

Our pod is growing, and as new brands join, we're adding an Account Manager so every brand gets the attention and strategic care it deserves. You'll be the day-to-day lead for a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands on TikTok Shop, with a West Coast-based Senior Account Manager beside you on strategy and escalations, and you'll have the availability to work Pacific hours alongside your pod. The pod structure is new, so you'll help shape how it runs, and there's a clear path to Senior Account Manager as you grow.

**What you'll do**
------------------

You'll be the main point of contact for each brand in your portfolio and the owner of each account's plan and results. A typical week includes leading client calls, reviewing performance in Seller Center and Cruva, adjusting GMV Max ads against ROI targets, and turning each brand's goals into clear assignments for your pod. You'll work most closely with your pod's Creator Manager and Ops Specialist, who handle creators, sampling, and shop operations, and you'll partner with brand teams and their TikTok reps on launches, promotions, and product plans.

* Own GMV against plan for each brand in your portfolio
* Lead weekly client calls, including strategy and product planning conversations
* Assign and track work across your Creator Manager and Ops Specialist based on each account's goals
* Manage GMV Max ads day to day, including budgets and ROI targets, with input from Ops
* Build hero SKU, offer, promotion, and campaign plans with each brand, including launches and seasonal events
* Dig into what's driving performance up or down, and share what you learn across the pod
* Keep every account organized with clear owners, next steps, and fast client response times
* Manage relationships with each brand's TikTok Shop rep

**What you'll need**
--------------------

* 2+ years of experience in marketing, e-commerce, or agency roles
* Hands-on TikTok Shop experience and a working understanding of how the platform and its seller services work. Six months or more is ideal.
* Experience leading client calls and presenting strategy or product plans directly to brands
* Experience managing multiple accounts or projects at once while keeping owners, timelines, and next steps clear
* Experience directing or assigning work to teammates based on goals and priorities
* A track record of digging into why results changed and turning that into a clear recommendation

**What we'd like you to have**
------------------------------

* GMV Max experience. You'll run GMV Max ads on your accounts, so it shortens your ramp, but we'll train strong candidates who haven't used it yet.
* Brand-side TikTok Shop or Meta experience, or time at TikTok or another TikTok Shop agency. It helps you understand what brands need from us and how the platform works from the inside.
* Interest in beauty. Most of our brands are in beauty and wellness, so it helps you speak their language from day one.

**What we require**
-------------------

* You'll work from our Midtown Manhattan office four days a week, Monday through Thursday.
* **Regular overlap with Pacific time hours**. Your pod and many of its clients are on the West Coast, so plan for your day to run later than a typical East Coast schedule, with flexibility beyond that when clients need it.

**What we're counting on from you**
-----------------------------------

In your first 90 days, we'll be looking for you to take full ownership of your portfolio. That means you're leading every weekly client call, sending agendas ahead and recaps within 24 hours, and keeping a current plan for each brand that you review weekly with your Senior Account Manager. You'll have taken over GMV Max ads on your accounts with budgets and ROI targets in place, set a regular rhythm with each brand's contacts and TikTok Shop rep, and spotted at least one account risk early enough to fix it before it showed up in results.

By the end of your first year, you'll have built a quarterly strategy plan for each brand, led a quarterly business review on your own, and taken a product launch from plan through results. You'll be the pod's go-to person on GMV Max, your learnings will be shaping how other brands and pods work, and you'll have mentored a newer teammate along the way.

If you know TikTok Shop and want to own real accounts with real support behind you, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Spotlight Media**
-------------------------

Spotlight Media is a leading, award-winning TikTok Shop agency and an official TikTok Shop Partner. We help brands and creators scale on TikTok Shop through end-to-end management, paid creator campaigns, and a constant growth strategy mindset. We’re profitable, fully bootstrapped, and growing extremely fast.

Spotlight is a place for high-agency people who want ownership and autonomy and can operate with speed. Much of what we need hasn’t been built yet, and the people who join now will shape it. Our mission is for the time you spend at Spotlight to be the most rewarding time in your career.

**Benefits**
------------

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Take-as-needed PTO after 90 days
* Office supply stipend
* Company bonuses
* Employee referral bonuses
* Brand referral bonuses

-

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Spotlight Media is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Compensation Range: $55K - $110K

jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!

**Job Summary**
---------------

As a Community Account Manager, you will be assigned a portfolio of muti-dwelling unit properties. The primary responsibility as CAM, is to grow and maintain market share by selling new movers, win-back customers, and upgrade existing customers to maximize monthly recurring revenue. Additionally, our CAM, will develop and manage the onsite relationship with the leasing staff, to ensure we are maximizing the terms of our marketing agreement, driving growth through educating staff and residents about the value of our products and reliability of our service, while positioning Optimum favorably against competitors and for contract renewals. In this role, you will be assigned new properties ensuring we maximize MDU new build customer penetration by working with onsite sales personnel and internal field operations to be “first to the door”.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Consistent achievement of monthly sales, revenue quotas and key performance indicators.
* Coordinate marketing events and cultivate relationships with sales, leasing staff and HOA's representing our brand, products while providing service excellence.
* Conduct site and virtual visits with property staff, updating and replenishing sales collateral, and educating leasing staff about new and existing product offers and the value of the optimum brand.
* Schedule quarterly/semi-annual reviews with property staff to “walk” the property, understand business trends and share property performance against established targets.
* Act as a liaison between property management and our internal Technical Operations, Construction Department and Sales Support to address service issues that impacts our ability to deliver on-time and exceptional service.
* Timely tracking and reporting of all sales, events, visits, and property escalations.
* Act as a point of contact with Bulk Property management staff, coordinating new customer onboarding and de-bulk events.
* All other duties assigned by your supervisor.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 5+ years related experience.
* Ability to travel up to 75%
* Strong communication skills are a must.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite programs is required.
* Business Development experience with emphasis on new customer acquisition and relationship management.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work independently.
* Computer skills, including Windows-based applications, and the ability to work within Salesforce and sales order entry and CRM platforms.
* Strong people and relationship management skills.
* Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license in good standing within the state of current residence.

At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stops.

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

jobs.description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

**How We Work: AI-First by Design**
===================================

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to the same standard. Everyone at Harmonic actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building processes and automating workflows. We expect every new hire to bring curiosity about AI and a willingness to use it to work smarter, faster, and more creatively. For some roles, that means tinkering and staying open to new tools. For others, it means building entirely new systems with AI at the core. We'll be clear about what we expect for each role, and we'll give you the tools and support to get there.

**About the Team**
==================

You will report to the Director of Customer Success and work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering team leaders. Our Customer Success team delivers a world-class experience for every customer. We don't believe in one-size-fits-all. Instead, we take a deep partnership approach to help customers realize their vision and achieve meaningful business outcomes through Harmonic.

**About the Role**
==================

As a Customer Success Manager at Harmonic, you'll own the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal, for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. You'll be a trusted advisor to both executive and technical stakeholders, building the kind of deep partnerships that drive adoption, retention, and long-term value.

This role calls for someone who is comfortable operating across levels: as confident walking a security engineer through a deployment as presenting business outcomes to a CISO. You don't need a purely technical background, but you'll need to earn the trust of technical buyers and speak their language. Whether your path here was through customer success, technical account management, or solutions engineering, what matters most is that you're energized by the customer relationship and committed to their success.

You'll also play a foundational role in helping Harmonic build the playbooks, processes, and metrics that will scale with us as we grow.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers are fully deployed, actively using Harmonic, and realizing measurable ROI on an agreed timeline.
* Renewals and NRR metrics are strong, with clear adoption milestones hit on schedule.
* QBRs drive executive alignment and reinforce Harmonic as a strategic security partner, not just a vendor.
* Technical blockers are resolved quickly and customers feel genuinely well-supported throughout the lifecycle.
* Customer insights are consistently shaping our product roadmap and go-to-market strategy

**What You Bring**
==================

* 5–8+ years in customer success, technical account management, or sales engineering, with a demonstrated preference and passion for the post-sale customer relationship.
* Experience working for a startup
* Experience leading complex enterprise onboardings and driving deep product adoption in technical environments.
* Strong analytical skills and fluency with CS metrics: NRR, GRR, CSAT, time-to-value, and product usage data.
* Exceptional communication skills: you can translate complex technical concepts for executive audiences and business value back into technical requirements.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
### **Why We Need You**

Defense primes and top federal integrators run their proposals on GovEagle inside FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud, from our web app, Word, and SharePoint. We've grown 5x in revenue and 10x in daily users, and our customers expect answers in minutes: we hold ourselves to a first reply within 15 minutes. Fast, reliable help and real adoption are why customers renew and refer their peers.

We're adding a Customer Success Manager to own a book of accounts from kickoff through renewal. You'll make sure every team that buys GovEagle actually uses it: run onboarding and trainings, keep accounts healthy, and lead renewal and expansion conversations alongside sales. We want someone who holds a high bar for speed and follow-through, builds the playbooks the next CSM will use, and is comfortable creating urgency when a rollout stalls.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own a book of accounts end to end.** Kickoff, onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion, with a clear plan for every account.
* **Respond fast.** First reply to customer messages in Teams and email within 15 minutes during business hours; resolve common issues the same day.
* **Run onboarding and trainings.** Coordinate SharePoint and SSO setup with customer IT teams, provision users, and lead trainings and office hours for proposal teams.
* **Drive renewals.** Track each account's goals, push for decisions, and partner with sales on renewal and expansion conversations.
* **Watch account health.** Use usage data to spot risk early and act on it long before renewal.
* **Build the playbooks.** Onboarding checklists, training decks, help articles, and release notes that make every next account faster.
* **Escalate cleanly.** Reproduce issues, write tickets engineers can act on right away, and close the loop with the customer.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Bring patterns in feedback and requests back to product and engineering.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 2 to 5 years in customer success, account management, or implementation at a B2B software company, ideally a fast-growing startup. Or proposal, capture, or BD experience at a government contractor and a strong pull toward software.
* A track record of owning outcomes: renewals, adoption, or pilots you drove to a result.
* Fast and organized: you answer quickly, follow up without being asked, and keep every commitment visible.
* Comfortable with direct conversations: you can push a customer on timelines, usage, and next steps while keeping the relationship strong.
* A clear communicator who can run a training for a room of proposal managers.
* Tech-savvy and quick with new tools; Microsoft 365 and SharePoint experience is a plus.
* You use AI tools every day to work faster, and you know where not to trust them.
* U.S. citizen (required): our customers work in environments subject to export controls.
* Based in New York City and able to work in our office four days a week, or based in the Washington, DC area and working remotely with occasional travel to New York and customer sites.

**Nice to have:** Government contracting, proposal management (APMP), or defense experience; experience at a YC or other venture-backed startup. No GovCon background needed; we'll teach you the domain.

### **What success looks like in your first 90 days**

* **30 days:** Answering customer inbound alongside the team, running your first trainings, and shadowing renewals.
* **60 days:** You own a book of accounts and have run an onboarding end to end; your first playbook is live.
* **90 days:** Your accounts hit their renewal milestones on time, most questions are resolved without engineering, and every account has a health review on the calendar.

### **About GovEagle**

GovEagle's AI platform helps government contractors win more work. Our AI agents dramatically reduce RFP response times by helping teams shred requirements, build compliance matrices, deliver exhaustive outlines, and draft compelling narratives. We're well capitalized ($10M from Y Combinator, Strategic Cyber Ventures, Sorenson Capital, and others) and based in NYC. Benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); generous PTO.

**How we hire:** a founder conversation, a customer scenario exercise (a short training walkthrough and a few real, anonymized customer messages), and a half-day onsite in New York. About two weeks. Don't meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

Compensation Range: $90K - $130K

jobs.description:
**About Sent**

Sent is a developer tool for customer engagement. We help developers and agents deliver messages across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS through a single API. Our intelligent routing model automates channel selection, ensuring lower cost and global deliverability without channel-specific integrations. Our built-in multitenancy also enables our customers to deploy messaging and voice agents across their own customers.

We recently closed a $12M Series A backed by Companyon Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, UIF, and others. We're hiring the best to scale a best-in-class platform.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to own and grow relationships with our existing customers, driving retention, revenue growth, and long-term customer value.

You'll be responsible for ensuring customers are successfully utilizing their commitments, identifying opportunities to expand their usage, and building strong relationships key profiles. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Solutions to understand customer goals, proactively address risks, and maximize the value of each account.

This is a commercial, relationship-driven role with significant ownership. You'll help establish the processes and strategies that make customer success a scalable, revenue-driving function at Sent.

**What You'll Do**

**What We're Looking For**

jobs.title: Client Success Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Rebar**
---------------

Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email.

Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years.

Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week.

We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next.

Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment.

We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to.

**About the Engineering Org**
-----------------------------

The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are:

* Everyone operates like an owner
* Find a way
* We win together

That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams.

As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it.

You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers.

You can think about this role almost as a forward-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion.

We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own customer data work
* Build and maintain integrations
* Handle customer API requests
* Scope technical requirements with customers
* Be the escalation path for technical issues
* Turn one-offs into product

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000-row CSV with inconsistent columns.

We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 2+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code
* Strong Python for scripting and data work
* Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (we're on Postgres)
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks
* Comfortable talking directly with customers, from end users to technical stakeholders
* Writes things down. Your integrations and scripts should be documented well enough that someone else can run them.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Familiarity with TypeScript and React
* Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB)
* Experience with GraphQL
* Experience with integration platforms or unified APIs (e.g., Merge)
* Background in construction, HVAC/mechanical, or another legacy industry
* Familiarity with estimating, takeoff, ERP, or project management tools used in construction
* Worked at an early-stage or high-growth startup

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

* **Salary**: Competitive base salary
* **Equity**: Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience
* **Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* **Perks**:

  + Agentic tooling budget
  + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time)
  + Great culture in a high-energy office

This is a full-time, on-site role in NYC’s Flatiron District, steps from Madison Square Park and Union Square.

Occasional travel for on-site customer visits.

*Equal Opportunity*

*Rebar is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Compensation Range: $120K - $165K

Major League Baseball is looking for a Gameday Operations Coordinator in the Baseball Operations department to support several aspects of gameday operations across all 30 Major League ballparks. This includes providing real-time support and oversight for the consistent execution of the Pitch Clock, the Automated Ball and Strike System, and providing essential support in collaboration with on-site monitors to ensure adherence to MLB's gameday compliance regulations.

*Pitch Clock Operation*

* Provide support for the operation of the Pitch Clock during Major League games

* Track Pitch Clock data and trends throughout the season and analyze their potential implications

* Communicate effectively with Gameday Compliance Monitors to provide guidance and address questions and issues that arise

jobs.title: Development Assistant
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Development Assistant is responsible for supporting the Development Department at large at Planned Parenthood of Greater New York. This role will report to the Director, Annual Giving and be responsible for many diverse administrative tasks across Development teams such as the acknowledgement letter process, supporting the annual fund and direct mail programs. The Development Assistant will do equal work across the Special Events and Institutional Funding teams with event management, meeting coordination, data entry, and system-building work.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Create a unified gift acknowledgement process with built-in quality control processes. This includes acknowledgement letters signed by the CEO, Honor/Memorial gift acknowledgements and cards, Special Event tickets and contribution acknowledgements, and Institutional Funding acknowledgements.
* Provide timely and reader-friendly notifications of gifts to internal and external stakeholders.
* Support the planning and execution of the Annual Campaign each fall, including the creation, merging, and mailing of solicitation materials.
* Support maintaining systems built around the President’s Circle (PC) donor affinity group, and other administrative and organizational tasks.
* Assist with administrative tasks pre-and-post event, as well day-of onsite work at Special Events across NY State.
* Provide high level support to the Chief Development Officer and Vice President, Individual Giving and Special Events, including schedule management, routing of inquiries via phone and e-mail, and other administrative tasks as needed.
* Manage the general Development and President’s Circle inboxes, working across the department to answer questions and address any donor issues in a timely manner.
* Provide administrative support to Institutional Funding on a project basis, including systems building, data entry, acknowledgement letters, and gift tracking.

**REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES**

* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills with the ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple tasks and responsibilities.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to quickly learn organizational tone and voice.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to participate in some evening and weekend events as needed.
* Ability to work well with others.
* An understanding of the role that racial inequity plays in our society and its impact on healthcare systems and institutions.
* A basic understanding of how race dynamics impact relationships and organizational culture, and a willingness to learn about how to successfully intervene in problematic dynamics and deepen a racial equity approach within an organization, team, service, program, or campaign.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Requires sitting for long periods of time. Periodic standing, walking, and bending. Requires lifting of up to 15 pounds. Visual acuity sufficient to perform frequent work on a computer screen and review printed reports and other materials. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets. Requires the ability to hear and to communicate orally with others.

**PPGNY's benefits package includes:**

Generous PTO and holiday schedule

Medical, dental and vision coverage options for you and eligible dependents

FSA, HSA, Commuter pre-tax reimbursement funds

Short- and Long-Term Disability, Free Basic Life and AD&D

401(k) Retirement Plan with Safe Harbor contributions after 1 year of employment

**All positions at PPGNY require:**

Proof of immunization or immunity to certain communicable diseases (including influenza during the flu season and Covid-19) and testing for tuberculosis. These certifications are required by the NYC DOHMH Health Code, NYSDOH and OSHA.

Planned Parenthood of Greater New York (PPGNY) is a leading provider, educator, and advocate of sexual and reproductive health care in New York State. PPGNY is proud to provide a wide-range of family planning services at our brick-and-mortar health centers and mobile care units. We care for everyone regardless of their immigration status, zip code or ability to pay. PPGNY’s education and outreach programs are backed by medically accurate, evidence-based information that allows people to make informed decisions about their health and future. As a voice for reproductive freedom, PPGNY supports legislation and policies that ensure all New Yorkers have access to the full range of reproductive health care and education.

At PPGNY, we provide the absolute best care to our patients and our communities through innovative health care delivery and education programming. We care for everyone who walks through our doors regardless of insurance, ability to pay or immigration status. As a leading voice for reproductive freedom, PPGNY fiercely advocates for policies to ensure that all New Yorkers will have access to the full range of reproductive health care services and information.

PPGNY is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe we are most impactful when people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and identities come together with common purpose. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Marketing Assistant (NYC Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Overview:

The HarperOne imprint, a division of HarperCollins Publishers, is seeking a Marketing Assistant. HarperOne is dedicated to bringing forth stories and ideas that inspire, transform, and spark meaningful change. We publish across a range of categories including health and wellness, spirituality, memoir, self-development, psychology and more.

This is a hybrid position based out of our New York office

Responsibilities:

* Supports Marketing Directors with campaigns seasonally and works on a few marketing campaigns independently, with supervision
* Under close supervision, liaises with publicity, editorial, ad/promo, sales, and digital marketing on campaign execution
* Under close supervision, writes copy and provides design direction for social media posts/assets, trade and consumer letters, email blasts, newsletters, and other marketing assets
* Assists imprint with influencer outreach and ongoing influencer efforts
* Coordinates scheduling for online/social media advertising campaigns
* Performs general administrative duties including mailings, scheduling meetings, and other departmental tasks
* Supports imprint with seasonal meeting tasks and preparation

Qualifications:

* Motivated and driven with a love for books and eagerness to learn about publishing and marketing
* Excellent organizational skills, exceptional attention to detail, and ability to multi-task
* Excellent writing and communication skills
* Marketing experience preferred, prior internship experience in publishing and/or marketing a plus
* Strong knowledge of social media (i.e. TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Reddit), video creation skills a plus
* Ability to work independently while contributing to department goals
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented environment
* An eye for design, as well as a knowledge of Canva and Photoshop a plus
* College degree or equivalent work experience

HarperCollins Publishers is a company full of people who are passionate about books. When you apply for a position, we want to know why you want to work here, and why you are interested in the job. **That’s why cover letters are strongly preferred.**

The salary for this position is **$52,500.** We recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, we aim for flexibility in structuring competitive compensation offers to ensure we are able to attract the best candidates. In addition to cash compensation, the company provides a comprehensive and highly competitive benefits package, with a variety of physical health, retirement and savings, caregiving, emotional wellbeing, transportation, and other benefits, including "elective" benefits employees may select to best fit the needs and personal situations of our diverse workforce. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Kirkland & Ellis**

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

**What You’ll Do**

As an Executive Assistant, you’ll provide high-level administrative and operational support to the Senior Director of Administration within Kirkland & Ellis LLP’s New York Office Operations & Administration team. You’ll serve as a trusted, highly visible partner, managing complex priorities, facilitating communication, coordinating initiatives, and helping ensure the office operates smoothly. Success in this role calls for sound judgment, discretion, accuracy, flexibility, and the ability to anticipate needs while building strong relationships across the Firm.

The schedule for this position is:  

* Monday through Friday, 9:30 a.m. – 5:30 p.m. with flexibility for overtime

  

* Own executive support: Manage a complex, evolving calendar; coordinate recurring and ad hoc meetings; resolve scheduling conflicts; and research, prioritize, and follow up on incoming requests, including sensitive and confidential matters.
* Coordinate travel and expenses: Arrange domestic and international travel, accommodations, itineraries, and ground transportation, and prepare expense reports while tracking timely reimbursement.
* Keep priorities moving: Track deadlines, decisions, follow-up items, and key initiatives to support timely execution and help leadership stay ahead of competing priorities.
* Develop polished communications: Prepare, compose, proofread, edit, compile, and distribute correspondence, presentations, reports, agendas, meeting materials, and other business documents.
* Coordinate office operations: Support leadership and committee meetings, conference calls, office events, visitors, special projects, new-hire onboarding, practice assistant assignments, office moves, and related reporting.
* Partner across the Firm: Collaborate with Human Resources, Accounting, Technology, Facilities, Marketing, General Services, Practice Services, Operations, and Guest Services to address office needs and advance strategic initiatives.
* Build trusted relationships: Serve as a professional liaison among Firm leadership, attorneys, business professionals, and external contacts while delivering responsive, high-quality internal client service.
* Maintain organization and confidentiality: Keep records and documentation organized, follow Firm policies and confidentiality standards, and provide day-to-day administrative support as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Education: A Bachelor of Arts/Science (BA/BS) or equivalent experience is required.
* Relevant experience: A minimum of 5 years work experience, in a professional services firm supporting a senior level executive in a fast-paced environment is required.
* Organization and precision: Exceptional organization and accuracy, with the ability to manage changing priorities, deadlines, logistics, and detailed work effectively.
* Judgment and discretion: Sound judgment and professionalism when handling sensitive information, confidential matters, and requests requiring thoughtful action or escalation.
* Initiative and adaptability: The ability to anticipate needs, work independently, adjust as priorities evolve, and take on additional responsibilities as capabilities grow.
* Communication and collaboration: Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with Firm leadership, attorneys, business professionals, cross-functional teams, and external contacts.

If you’re ready to bring exceptional organization, judgment, and proactive support to a highly visible Executive Assistant role, we’d love to hear from you!

**Compensation**

The base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in New York. This range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. At Kirkland & Ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. We offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation Range:

New York: $88,000 - $120,000

**How to Apply**

Thank you for your interest in Kirkland & Ellis LLP. To complete an application and submit your resume, please click "Apply Now."

*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others at Kirkland.*

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

All employment decisions, including the recruiting, hiring, placement, training availability, promotion, compensation, evaluation, disciplinary actions, and termination of employment (if necessary) are made without regard to the employee’s race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy or childbirth, personal appearance, family responsibilities, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, political affiliation, source of income, place of residence, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military veteran status, unfavorable discharge from military service, physical or mental disability, or on any other basis prohibited by applicable law. #LI-Hybrid #LI-KK1

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Project Coordinator

**Company:** Loenbro, LLC  
**Business Unit/Department:** Southeast
  
**Location:** Douglas, GA/ On-site  
**Reports to:** Project Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**FLSA Classification:** Non-Exempt

**About Loenbro**

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

  

**At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose.** Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

  

**Job Summary**

The Field Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and completion of field-based projects. This role serves as a critical liaison between project managers, field personnel, subcontractors, clients, and vendors to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with company quality standards.

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

  

**Project Coordination**

* Assist Project Managers with the planning, scheduling, and execution of field projects.
* Coordinate project activities, resources, equipment, and personnel.
* Monitor project schedules and communicate progress updates to stakeholders.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Support project startups, mobilization, and closeout activities.

**Field Operations Support**

* Conduct site visits to monitor project progress and ensure compliance with project specifications.
* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, and vendors to maintain workflow efficiency.
* Ensure field activities are completed in accordance with safety regulations and company procedures.
* Assist with resolving field-related issues and identifying corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of site activities, labor hours, and equipment utilization.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain project documentation including daily reports, schedules, change orders, permits, and project logs.
* Track project costs, purchase orders, and invoices.
* Generate status reports for project managers and leadership teams.
* Ensure all project records are organized and updated throughout the project lifecycle.

**Client & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a point of contact for customers, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Facilitate project meetings and document meeting minutes and action items.
* Communicate schedule changes, project updates, and field conditions to stakeholders.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients and project partners.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Assist with job hazard analyses, site inspections, and safety audits.
* Verify compliance with contractual requirements, permits, and regulatory standards.
* Report and document incidents, near misses, and safety concerns.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with project management software is preferred.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in fast-paced field environments.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

  

* Associate's degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent field experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

* 2+ years of project coordination, construction, industrial, utilities, telecommunications, or related field experience preferred.
* Experience supporting field operations and managing project documentation.
* Familiarity with subcontractor coordination and project scheduling.

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

**Work Environment:**

  

* Ability to travel to project sites as needed.
* Ability to work both in office and field environments.
* Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to walk construction or industrial sites and work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

*This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.*

**Benefits**

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Life and disability insurance
* Professional development and training opportunities

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Office of Undergrad Education - Accommodated Testing Service
jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

Program Coordinator, OUE Accommodated Testing Services

This is a 9-month position (August – May)

**Emory College of Arts and Sciences** (Emory College), founded in 1836, is Emory University’s primary undergraduate division with more than 5,700 students. Its intensive liberal arts curriculum is backed by all the resources of one of the world's top research universities. Emory College plays a critical role in supporting and expanding the liberal arts throughout the University and its nine

undergraduate and professional schools. This effort is led by the College’s renowned 550-member faculty who bring their path-breaking research – and commitment to excellent teaching – to the classroom. With more than 50 departments and programs, 86 majors, and 63 minors, Emory College students pursue rigorous courses of study that emphasize critical thinking, the nature of evidence from multiple perspectives and the ability to effectively reason and communicate. Emory College students are encouraged – and expected – to ask bold questions and expand the boundaries of knowledge.

The **Office for Undergraduate Education (OUE)** stewards the academic experience of undergraduates in Emory College. It promotes academic excellence by providing leadership and support across the College, both curricular and co-curricular. The OUE advances the vision of Emory College by collaborating with its faculty and Emory University partners to deliver a transformative liberal arts education. In this endeavor, it co-creates academic experiences that enable each Emory College student to reach their full potential and contribute meaningfully to Emory University’s mission to “create, preserve, teach and apply knowledge in the service of humanity.”

OUE Accommodated Testing Service (ACTS) offers in-person, proctored exams for undergraduate students in Emory College courses with Department of Accessibility Services (DAS) accommodations. OUE ACTS facilitates thousands of exams annually and plays a critical role in supporting equitable access to assessment for undergraduate students. This full-time, 9-month position is housed in the Office for Undergraduate Education as part of the Academic Affairs and Faculty Partnerships team.

**Atlanta Legal Aid Society** (“Legal Aid”) seeks a **Community Outreach and Content Administrator**. Founded in 1924, our non-profit law firm represents low-income people in a variety of civil legal matters, including family, housing, consumer, public benefits, education, and health law in a five-county service area (Clayton, Cobb, DeKalb, Fulton, and Gwinnett). Legal Aid employs more than 140 staff and operates five offices and numerous units, programs, and projects throughout its service area. Our clients and their legal issues are diverse and numerous.

Reporting to the Practice Innovation Manager, the Community Outreach and Content Administrator contributes directly to Atlanta Legal Aid's efforts by connecting with the community, expanding public access to legal resources, and implementing innovative legal outreach strategies. This role is a pivotal resource, requiring a deep understanding of the organization’s services and client-facing tools to effectively oversee educational initiatives, outreach strategies, and content development. This position will coordinate cross-departmental efforts, maintain sustainable outreach frameworks, and collaborate with partners to amplify Atlanta Legal Aid’s impact. This position manages Georgia’s Law Help website, as well as additional content management. The Administrator will also manage key digital resources, ensuring their effectiveness in supporting the organization's mission. The position is based out of our downtown Atlanta office. Occasional travel outside the Atlanta metropolitan area may be required.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Content & Website Management:**

  + Collaborate with stakeholders to maintain and optimize Georgia’s Law Help website, both in English and Spanish.
  + Lead aspects of maintaining content in accordance with Georgia Legal Aid’s style guide and review processes.
  + Coordinate volunteer attorneys, translators, and legal professionals in updating and maintaining content on GeorgiaLegalAid.org and AyudaLegalGeorgia.org.
  + Manage and maintain the function and knowledge base of Atlanta Legal Aid’s public facing informational chat bot in collaboration with attorneys and vendors.
  + Support additional digital legal aid resources and websites.
  + Maintain and expand a comprehensive community resource list to improve client referral processes and service coordination.
  + Play a key role in the development, implementation and management of Atlanta Legal Aid’s automated content management system, serving as coordinator for reviewers once implemented.
  + Coordinate reviewers of Atlanta Legal Aid’s automated content management system, changes in the law, external resources, and feedback from internal and external stakeholders, to determine content impact.
* **Reporting & Grant Support:**

  + Monitor user interactions and conversations within Atlanta Legal Aid’s public facing informational chat bot to report on common themes for advocacy efforts, as well as outreach and education gaps.
  + Use relevant data, including Google Analytics, user feedback, and other relevant data to help prioritize updates in subject areas of responsibility.
  + Facilitate bi-annual reviews of outreach initiatives and engagement with staff to refine community outreach approaches.
  + Participate in reporting for technology grants.
* **Community Education & Outreach:**

  + Support the internal outreach structure to strengthen relationships with community partners and underserved communities through technology assets (e.g. Community Partner Portal, Outreach Calendar).
  + Spearhead community education events, including live legal education sessions, webinar series, and interactive learning experiences.
  + Oversee legal education presentation requests and ensure quality control and impact measurement of educational and training efforts.
  + Participate in efforts to enhance Atlanta Legal Aid’s visibility through digital campaigns, social media outreach, and community-based marketing initiatives.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Self-motivated, with the ability to establish priorities and manage multiple tasks effectively with minimal supervision.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a mission-driven team.
* Excellent proficiency with office productivity tools, including Google Workspace.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, managing attorneys and managers, and organizational leadership.
* Fully bilingual, with excellent oral and written proficiency in both Spanish and English.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree is strongly preferred.
* Content and website management experience required.
* Demonstrated experience training and coordinating others in the use of technology.

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**

  

In 1976, ten independent hauliers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

DSV is looking for an Operational Account Manager to own the day-to-day execution, customer relationships, and overall account performance within our domestic freight brokerage operation. This role combines hands-on transportation operations with customer account management, giving you direct ownership of shipments from initial request and pricing through pickup, transit, and final delivery.

  

You'll work closely with customers, Carrier Sales, carriers, and internal teams to develop transportation solutions that balance service, capacity, pricing, and customer-specific requirements. Along the way, you'll maintain shipment visibility, communicate proactively with customers, resolve exceptions, provide pricing direction, and ensure freight moves efficiently and according to plan.

  

Beyond managing individual shipments, you'll develop and manage your assigned accounts by analyzing transportation spend, service performance, and shipment trends, leading customer business reviews, and identifying opportunities to improve performance and expand existing relationships. Whether that means adding lanes, increasing shipment volume, introducing additional services, or developing solutions to a customer challenge, you'll play an active role in growing the business you support.

  

If you bring domestic freight brokerage or transportation experience, strong customer relationship management skills, and the ability to stay ahead of changing operational demands, this is an opportunity to take real ownership of your accounts while building your career with the world's largest freight forwarding and logistics company.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, developing strong, long-term relationships through proactive communication, consistent service, and effective account management.
* Manage day-to-day freight brokerage operations for assigned accounts, overseeing shipment execution from initial customer request and pricing through pickup, transit, and final delivery.

* Prepare and present customer reporting, including transportation spend, service performance, operational metrics, and other account-related information.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, including Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), to evaluate account performance, address concerns, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Identify and develop opportunities to expand existing customer relationships through additional lanes, increased shipment volume, expanded services, and other transportation solutions.

* Maintain knowledge of transportation market conditions, carrier capacity, pricing trends, customer requirements, and available service solutions to support operational and account management decisions.

Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management. As an on-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management
* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop on-site staff
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Complete weekly/daily office & maintenance staff schedules and assignments
* Deal effectively and consistently with performance problems; document adequately, communicate with direct supervisor and HR, and terminate appropriately when necessary.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management
* Achieve the highest possible net operating income through the implementation of effective cost control and revenue & leasing improvement; identify trends and recommend strategies and adjustments
* Develop yearly operating budgets/forecasts
* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.
* Monitor the timely receipt, reconciliation, and coding of all vendor invoices
* Ensure property closeout is completed on time and ownership financial reports are accurate
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Develop yearly marketing plan and utilize marketing strategies & systems
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents
* Administrative & Maintenance Management
* Ensure all administrative & leasing reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted on a timely basis
* Will head emergency team for the property; ensure proper response and handling of all property emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc., within company guidelines to minimize liability.
* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)
* Give direction to and monitor maintenance, construction, and rehabilitation activities to ensure quality and expediency (i.e., “walk” units to ensure make-ready and work orders are completed)

**Education/experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or four year’s experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

### **Logistics Coordinator Job, Alpharetta, GA (Hybrid)**

**Arclin USA LLC** is searching for talent for a **Logistics Coordinator Job** out of our Alpharetta office and **reporting into the NAR Regional Truck Manager.** This position is primarily responsible for ensuring customers satisfaction through delivery, service, inventory accuracy and quality. Works very closely with Planning, Production, the plant’s sub-contracted Freight Company, and Sales to coordinate movement of product to meet customer requirements while minimizing all demurrage charges.

### **Position Summary**

The Logistics Coordinator supports the day-to-day execution and coordination of transportation activities across Arclin's logistics network. Based at Arclin's Alpharetta, GA headquarters and reporting to the NAR Regional Truck Manager, this role works closely with **manufacturing sites**, **warehouses**, **customer** **service**, **carriers, freight forwarders,** and other logistics service providers to ensure shipments are **scheduled, tendered, tracked, documented, and delivered safely, reliably, cost-effectively**, and in compliance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

The position provides **hands-on** **operational support** across multiple transportation modes with a focus on shipment execution, carrier coordination, transportation visibility, exception management, cost control, data accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.

#### **What You Will Do**

* Coordinate inbound, outbound, and interfacility transportation activities across assigned modes.
* Tender freight to approved carriers in accordance with established routing guidelines, routing guides, and carrier assignments.
* Confirm carrier acceptance, equipment availability, pickup requirements, and delivery requirements.
* Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments with carriers, manufacturing sites, warehouses, and customers.
* Track shipments from pickup through final delivery and maintain accurate shipment visibility.
* Proactively identify delayed, missed, or at-risk shipments and coordinate appropriate recovery actions.
* Escalate capacity, routing, cost, service, or compliance exceptions to the Modal Procurement Manager.
* Document routing deviations and support resolution of recurring transportation issues.
* Support truckload, LTL, bulk, parcel, rail, ocean, air, and intermodal transportation activities, as applicable.
* Coordinate critical and expedited shipments when required.
* Serve as a day-to-day operational contact for carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, and other logistics service providers.

#### **Carrier Performance, Cost & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor carrier performance, including on-time pickup and delivery, tender acceptance, capacity performance, claims, damages, and service exceptions.
* Maintain carrier scorecards and supporting transportation performance data.
* Prepare operational information and KPI data for carrier performance reviews and QBRs.
* Follow up with carriers on corrective actions, service failures, and open operational issues.
* Assist with freight claims, carrier complaints, and service issue resolution.
* Review transportation charges against shipment records, routing requirements, and applicable rate information.
* Monitor detention, demurrage, layover, redelivery, storage, premium freight, and other accessorial charges.
* Identify and support freight cost-savings and cost-mitigation opportunities by reducing avoidable accessorials, premium freight, service failures, and inefficient shipping practices.
* Support freight spend, transportation cost, savings, and operational performance reporting.
* Participate in process, technology, and continuous-improvement initiatives that improve transportation service, visibility, cost, and execution.

#### **Systems, Data & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate transportation information within ERP, TMS, WMS, transportation visibility, and reporting systems, as applicable.
* Maintain bills of lading, proof of delivery, shipment records, and other required transportation documentation.
* Verify shipment details including origin, destination, carrier, equipment type, weight, quantity, dates, and reference numbers.
* Ensure shipment and carrier information is entered accurately and updated in a timely manner.
* Maintain organized, accurate, and audit-ready transportation records.
* Perform transportation data analysis using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools.
* Support logistics KPI dashboards and recurring performance reporting.

#### **Compliance & Risk Management**

* Execute transportation activities in accordance with company policies, established routing guidelines, operating procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Apply appropriate knowledge of Incoterms when coordinating international shipments and transportation responsibilities.
* Maintain working knowledge of applicable domestic and international transportation and shipping regulations.
* Ensure required transportation and shipping documentation is complete and accurate.
* Coordinate with Trade Compliance and other internal stakeholders when shipments involve import/export, customs, dangerous goods, or other regulatory requirements.
* Escalate potential safety, regulatory, documentation, or trade compliance concerns.
* Support transportation exception management and contingency actions for capacity shortages, delays, weather events, equipment constraints, and other service disruptions.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transportation, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 2-4 years of relevant experience in logistics, transportation, shipping, distribution, warehousing, or supply chain operations.
* Experience working with carriers, freight brokers, freight forwarders, warehouses, or third-party logistics providers.
* Working knowledge of transportation routing gui

jobs.description:
### **About us and why we’re hiring...**

RoadSync is revolutionizing the logistics industry with intelligent, simple, and innovative financial solutions. Our digital platform streamlines payment processes for warehouses, carriers, brokers, and repair/tow operators, dramatically reducing processing time and maximizing revenue collection.

We are seeking an Implementation Specialist to onboard and activate new customers. You’ll own the early customer journey for your assigned accounts—from kickoff to first transaction to full ramp—and ensure every customer is actively using the product, not just set up.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

##### **Onboarding & Activation**

* Manage onboarding for your assigned customers from deal close through first transaction, aiming to complete onboarding within the month.
* This position may require travel (35%) to see clients.
* Keep implementations moving by identifying blockers early, sequencing setup steps, and hitting activation milestones.
* Guide customers through configuration, training, and their first live transactions.
* Validate business requirements upfront so each implementation is scoped correctly.

##### **Ramp & Feature Adoption**

* Track customer transaction volume weekly and flag accounts falling behind the expected ramp.
* Drive adoption of revenue-generating features, including hardware and special promotions.
* Use implementation playbooks to move customers from basic setup to full platform use.

##### **Retention & Transition**

* Monitor customer health in your portfolio and raise at-risk accounts early.
* Hand off customers to Account Management with documented notes: active transactions, features adopted, and next steps.
* Work with the Account Management team to keep transitions warm and customers engaged after handoff.

##### **Process & Knowledge Sharing**

* Follow and contribute to documented processes, playbooks, and knowledge base articles.
* Meet team KPIs and SLAs, and take coaching and feedback from your manager.
* Suggest process improvements and share them with your manager and Revenue Operations.

##### **Communication & Collaboration**

* Give your manager regular updates on onboarding progress and at-risk accounts.
* Share clear, data-backed feedback with Product, RevOps, and Support when you see activation blockers or process friction.
* Escalate issues with context and a recommended path forward.

#### **Qualifications**

##### **Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in customer success, implementation, or onboarding within a SaaS or payments technology environment.
* Experience managing customer onboarding or implementation projects focused on time-to-value and activation.
* Ability to review data, spot at-risk accounts, and act on what you find.
* Comfortable using a CRM (HubSpot a plus) for tracking customers, health, and reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable working with customers and cross-functional teams.

##### **Preferred**

* Experience in logistics, payments, or fleet services.
* Familiarity with merchant processing, transaction-based revenue, or platform fee models.
* Experience deploying hardware (payment terminals, mobile devices) during onboarding.
* Experience contributing to implementation playbooks, knowledge bases, or customer training.

#### **Why you’ll love it here...**

RoadSync is a team of passionate professionals who care deeply about what we do and bring our best every day. We value being a diverse and inclusive team and company. In addition to joining an innovative and passionate team, you will get:

* Competitive compensation package and company equity awarded on day 1!
* Three weeks (15 working days) of PTO annually
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits, with premiums paid for employees
* Exposure to the inner workings of a growing company, including open, transparent communication within our team. You will know what is happening and why it matters.
* Hybrid office, Downtown Atlanta, Georgia

*RoadSync is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and an Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, height, weight, veteran status, military obligations, pregnancy, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. Every day, our team is honored to work with individuals from all walks of life. We aim to build a team that reflects the diversity of our customers. Each individual at RoadSync brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them. We believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides a better service to our customers, and helps us grow and learn as individuals.*
