**Job Title:** Assistant Project Manager

**Company:** Loenbro, LLC  
**Business Unit/Department:** Southeast
  
**Location:** Douglas, GA / On-site  
**Reports to:** Project Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**FLSA Classification:** Exempt

**About Loenbro**

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

  

**At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose.** Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

  

**Job Summary**

The Assistant Project Manager is responsible for ensuring that the project(s) runs smoothly and if any issues occur, they are corrected immediately. This position will report to the Project Manager.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

  

* Maintain a daily project diary and help establish project priorities.
* Daily timecard entry and approval.
* Track and record project costs, production quantities, yield statistics, and onsite inventory counts.
* Compile cycle times and production information and log this information for historical data.
* Gather pay item quantities and collect information on extra work items.
* Conduct timely billing and reporting to maximize profit margins and positive cash flow.

**Skills**

* Strong computer skills required with a special emphasis on Excel skills.

  

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or construction management degree.
* Experience in the construction industry is preferred.
* Strong work ethic, ability to prioritize and excellent communication skills.
* Willingness to work both in field and office settings and an ability to work in a high production, fast moving environment.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

**Work Environment:**

  

* Potential exposure to extreme cold and hot temperatures.
* Manufacturing, pipeline, and refining environment.
* Fit and move in confined spaces including tanks and vessels.
* Limited working surfaces.
* Exposure to noise above 85 decibels and intense odors.
* Exposure to areas with limited visibility.

*This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.*

**Benefits**

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Life and disability insurance
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

*Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.*

Guided by **Core Values (LEAD)**, grounded in **grit** and a **commitment to excellence**, Loenbro **betters** our families, customers, and **local** communities.If you're ready to be part of a company that **LEADS** by:

* **L****iving with Integrity**
* **E****xceeding Expectations**
* **A****cting with Urgency**
* **D****elivering Excellence**

  

…we want to hear from you.

  

**Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

**YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT FOR THE TEAM IF YOU:**

* You are excited about being positioned right in the middle of the exploding cloud based economy and to develop and maintain a highly desired knowledge of Snowflake’s solutions.
* You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills.
* You have superb organization and contact management capabilities.
* You are driven to achieve your mission and you love bringing the team together to achieve results together.

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:**
---------------------------------

* Manage the relationship of 50-70 clients within a specific industry.
* Build trusted relationships with Snowflake internal resources, external partners, and client account teams to qualify deals, identify business value, and provide technical guidance in order to set proper expectations to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Align Snowflake’s value to the customers’ business and technical problems.
* Drive revenue and increase market share in defined set of accounts.
* Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving technology and landscape while maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.
* Work hands-on with customers to deliver standard, customized and/or strategic solution demonstrations, presentations, and best practices that showcase functional capabilities, competitive advantages, and business benefits of the Snowflake solutions throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation.
* Guides customers in digital transformation and cloud adoption, understanding where Snowflake integrates with holistic architecture and strategy.
* Provide ongoing, post-sales, technical guidance to the customer’s technical team to drive customer utilization of Snowflake and digital transformation success.

**ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:**
------------------------------------------

* 1+ years of sales experience full cycle sales or equivalent business to business sales experience.
* Proven ability to independently manage and develop client relationships.
* Ability to drive consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.
* Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.
* Proactive, independent thinking and a high energy/positive attitude.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.
* BA/BS preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

* This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on-target earnings of $140,000 - $183,750. The estimated base salary for this role is $84,000 - $110,250.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator I
jobs.description:
Partner with our highly skilled and talented engineers by supporting their day-to-day business needs for projects in various markets throughout the world. Syska Hennessy Group provides specialized consulting, engineering, and commissioning services for clients worldwide. Our staff provides consulting services throughout the project lifecycle, helping to plan, design, build, and operate technically superior facilities.  
  
Our dynamic work environment provides the optimal setting to take your engineering career to the next level. From our supportive culture, diverse workforce, and competitive compensation to our flexible work schedule Monday to Thursday in the office for 9 hours and Friday for 4 hours remotely at home and fun social events, you will need everything for an exciting, challenging, and rewarding career.

We currently have an exceptional opportunity for a self-motivated **Project Coordinator** to join our **Chicago, IL office**. The Project Coordinator is an integral member of the project team responsible for delivering engineering design services for building construction projects of varying size and complexity. The Project Coordinator is responsible for organizing and controlling project activities and supporting the project team with administrative tasks. The ideal candidate thrives in areas of initiative, quality of work, customer focus and meeting deadlines.

Project Coordinator additional responsibilities:

* Collaborate with PM in the drafting and issuance of project proposals, RFP's, budgets, cash flows and preliminary schedules
* Act as a liaison at a higher level on projects
* Responsible for tracking/monitoring project budget under direct supervision of the PM
* Oversee project organization and communication charts
* Manage the progress and quality of work being performed by design disciplines/trades
* Oversee contract execution tracking logs
* Collaborate with PM to review sub-contractor quotations to ensure that only fair and reasonable pricing is recommended for approval
* Manage contemplated change notices, change orders, and assist with collections support through proactive follow up with our clients to ensure timely payment
* Manage all required project close out documents and ensure all sub-contractor documentation is obtained
* Enter and update client proposals in Salesforce database

Administrative responsibilities:

* Coordinate appointment calendars, travel arrangements, and in coordinating and reviewing timesheets
* Perform data entry and assist with formatting and editing project specifications
* Assist corporate Human Resources by coordinating candidate interviews and performing I-9 verification for all new hires
* Take ownership of onboarding new hires by training for relevant system and processes
* Ensure all company documentation (hardcopy and electronic) is archived and purged according to the company's record retention schedule
* Coordinate site specific In House and Client events
* Ensure office facilities are well maintained, operating properly, and supplied

**Job Requirements**

* Associate degree in Architectural, Engineering, or Project Construction Management and/or experience supporting Project Mangers in the delivery of building construction projects
* Minimum of 7 plus years' experience as a project administrator, coordinator, or a similar role
* Understanding of architectural engineering and construction industry is *a must*
* Proficient in MS Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Intermediate proficiency with Adobe Acrobat
* Knowledge of Financial Force and Sales Force, highly preferred
* Strong multitasking and organizational skills, and proven ability to work effectively both independently and in a team-based environment.
* Flexibility for occasional overtime to meet project deadlines is required

**Benefits**

As an employee with Syska Hennessy Group, you will be part of a global firm with an amazing history! We are committed to be the best, to advancing engineering design practice, and to supporting our clients with integrity. To make all of that happen, we rely on the talent, drive, enthusiasm, and the total job satisfaction of the great people who work here.

As a member of our highly collaborative team, we provide you with a flexible benefits package that reflects our respect for your workplace contributions, professional goals, and personal priorities. The personal benefits program at Syska Hennessy Group includes:

* Robust, comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental benefit plans
* 401(k) plan with a generous employer matching program
* Training and professional development courses
* Professional development incentive bonuses
* Dynamic Employee Resource Groups
* Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) policy
* Transit/parking employer stipend
* ½ day work from home Fridays all year long

At Syska, we promote an environment that is committed to embedding diversity and equality into the core of our business and culture. We empower our employees so they can take ownership for their work and development and strive to continually improve themselves and our firm. Syska is a place where you can build an exceptional career and have a lasting impact on the world.

  

**Syska Hennessy Group**

**Integrating the best minds and technology to help clients create exceptional environments.**

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Overview**
  
Loyola University Chicago’s School of Law is a student-focused Law Center inspired by the Jesuit tradition of academic excellence, intellectual openness, and service to others. Learn more by visiting our website: **https://www.luc.edu/law/**

Led by the School of Law, the Holistic Immigration Hub (HIH) Pilot is designed to harness Loyola’s collaborative spirit and cross-disciplinary approach to recognize and restore the fundamental dignity of migrants in society and before the law. Leveraging powerful partnerships amongst the School of Law, Stritch School of Medicine, Parkinson School of Health Sciences and Public Health, and the Schools of Education and Social Work, the HIH Pilot advances novel legal pedagogy, interdisciplinary clinical training, and innovative research to develop a new generation of immigration lawyers, serve migrant children and families, and propel Loyola’s reputation as a leader in immigrant justice guided by Jesuit values.

This collaborative effort will achieve three goals:

* **Leadership:** Create a pipeline of the next generation of leaders and professionals.
* **Service:** Support Chicago community organizations and the children and families they serve.
* **Innovation:** Catalyze visionary, systemic change.
  

The Innovation Incubator is a component of the HIH Pilot designed to catalyze visionary systemic change in the immigration system utilizing interdisciplinary methods. Operationally, the Incubator functions as an integral partner of the Immigration Law Lab and the Immigration and Human Rights Clinic, also components of the HIH Pilot.

In the law school, the Incubator presents a unique opportunity for students to dive deeply into complex immigration issues while meeting the needs of our community collaborators through a technical assistance implementation model.

**Position Summary**

As part of the HIH Pilot, the Program Coordinator will work alongside the HIH Pilot team to launch the Innovation Incubator. The Program Coordinator will have primary responsibility for coordination of the Incubator through a technical assistance model. Specifically, the Program Coordinator will engage in developing and maintaining collaborative relationships with organizational stakeholders (“collaborators”) involved in the Innovation Incubator; develop internal and external protocols for tracking innovation requests and outcome documents; support faculty and staff engaging in outreach and site visits with Loyola’s organizational collaborators; track and analyze trends and other data in the assistance provided to Loyola collaborators; otherwise work collaboratively to launch this innovative new programming.

All Staff within the School of Law report to the Associate Dean for Administration. In addition, Staff are expected to work collaboratively to advance the goals of the HIH Pilot as outlined above and the strategic priorities established by the HIH Pilot. Staff are accountable to those responsible for overseeing the Pilot’s day-to-day operations.

*The position is grant-funded for a period of 2 years or as long as funds are available.*
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:**

In close collaboration with the leader of the Immigration clinic, the Program Coordinator will engage in the following duties:

* Creating the intake, management, and tracking system(s) for thematic technical assistance requests (innovation requests) handled by the Immigration Innovation Incubator.
* Providing technical and logistical support for Loyola Students from across disciplines in the efforts to respond to innovation requests.
* Developing protocols for accepting and tracking innovation requests and outcome documents;
* Identifying data points / metrics to capture and track to meaningfully illustrate impact of interdisciplinary research and outcome documents.
* Researching, proposing, and managing database(s) / software needed for robust and accurate tracking of innovation requests.
* Managing and tracking innovation requests and outcomes.
* Developing protocols for internal coordination of interdisciplinary research and responses.
* Supporting Holistic Immigration Hub (HIH) Faculty and Staff in:
  + Outreach and engagement with Immigration Innovation Incubator collaborators.
  + Interdisciplinary efforts across professional schools.
  + Reporting on Incubator’s work and outcomes.
  + Engaging in additional tasks and activities associated as assigned by the HIH Pilot team.

* Occasional assistance and thought partnership with the Immigration and Human Rights Clinic operations;
* Occasional assistance and thought partnership with the Immigration Law Lab;
* Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Inside Sales)
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (Inside Sales) - Chicago, IL**

**\*Must live in Chicago, IL or surrounding area\***

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a driven, curious, and resilient Sales Development Representative to join our Inside Sales Team. This is not a holding pattern role; it is the first chapter of a clearly defined career in sales.

As an SDR, you will be responsible for generating qualified meetings through a mix of outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. You will work closely with your field sales counterparts to hand off those meetings, ensuring every introduction is well-briefed, timely, and set up to convert.

This role is also the foundation of your sales career. The skills, commercial instincts, and client relationships you build here are what will prepare you for promotion to Business Development Manager within 6 to 12 months, where you will own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close.

This role is built on two foundations. First, execution: showing up, doing the work, and consistently delivering output. Second, growth: developing the judgment, curiosity, and persuasion skills that turn a good SDR into a great closer.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Pipeline generation**

* Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via phone, email, and other tools to identify and engage potential clients

* Qualify inbound leads using a structured framework, assessing fit, urgency, and decision-making authority

* Book qualified meetings and hand them off to a BDM with a thorough, well-prepared brief

* Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly activity and meeting targets

**Client engagement**

* Research target accounts before outreach, understand their business, hiring challenges, and the commercial impact of those challenges

* Ask enough of the right questions during outreach to qualify the opportunity and set your BDM up for a strong first conversation

* Handle common objections confidently and credibly, influencing rather than scripting your way through conversations

* Follow up on the outcomes of your handoffs, stay curious about what happens after the meeting is booked and use it to sharpen your approach

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with your BDM counterparts, providing thorough meeting briefs and acting as a reliable first point of contact for new prospects

* Keep Salesforce records accurate and up to date, logging all activity and tracking pipeline stages

* Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles, rapidly applying feedback to improve your approach

* Contribute to a culture of high activity, honest feedback, and shared accountability

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We hire for two things: the ability to execute today, and the potential to grow into a future closer. You do not need to have worked in staffing before. You do need to be the kind of person who finds a way to get things done.

**Execution — you deliver consistent output and pipeline**

Grit / Resilience

You sustain performance through rejection. A tough week doesn’t derail you — it sharpens your focus.

Activity Capacity

You are comfortable with high-volume outreach and bring structure and energy to every day.

Work Ethic / Discipline

You manage your own time, set your own targets, and don’t need close supervision to stay on track.

Coachability

You take feedback fast and apply it faster. You see coaching as a competitive advantage, not a criticism.

**Growth — you have the potential to become a future BDM**

Business Acumen

You connect hiring challenges to business impact. You ask why, not just what.

Discovery Depth

You ask the question behind the question. You don’t surface needs — you uncover them.

Ownership Mindset

You think beyond the meeting. You care about outcomes, not just activity.

Deal Curiosity

You want to know what happens after the handoff. You use those lessons to get better.

Persuasion Skills

You influence rather than script. You adapt to the person in front of you.

Internal Selling

You collaborate well. You know that winning externally starts with alignment internally.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* A genuine interest in sales and a clear desire to build a career as a closer

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, you can hold a conversation and write a compelling email

* A track record of hitting targets or goals in any context: work, academics, sport, or otherwise

* The ability to handle rejection and keep going without losing energy or professionalism

* Comfort with technology, CRM tools, LinkedIn and email sequencing platforms

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in a sales, customer-facing, or high-volume outreach role

* Exposure to the staffing, recruiting, or workforce solutions industry

* Experience using Salesforce and sales enablement platforms

* A degree in business, communications, or a related field, though we care more about drive than credentials

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

In your first 30 days, you will have completed onboarding, learned our solutions and client base, started your first outreach cadences, and booked your first qualified meetings.

By 90 days, you will be consistently hitting your meeting targets, running discovery calls with support, and actively contributing to pipeline. Your CRM will be clean, your activity levels high, and your feedback loops fast.

By 6 to 12 months, you will have demonstrated readiness to progress to Business Development Manager, running your own full-cycle deals, contributing to closed placements, and showing the commercial judgment and client relationships that a BDM role requires.

**CAREER PROGRESSION**

This role is the entry point to a structured sales career at our business. Promotion to Business Development Manager is performance-based, not tenure-based. SDRs who demonstrate the right competencies and hit the right thresholds can progress in as little as six months.

As a BDM, you will own the full sales cycle,

The position also coordinates documentation for faculty personnel processes and academic appeals, supports the Academic and Student Life Committee of the Board of Trustees, and monitors designated Academic Affairs budgets. The role requires initiative, sound judgment, discretion, and responsive service to faculty, staff, students, trustees, and external partners in keeping with Benedictine University’s Catholic and Benedictine mission.

new_jobs.description:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE:  
The Tech Performance Sales Representative mission is to build positive and lasting relationships with current and future retail partners, consumers, and the performance community with a focus on Running, Golf, and Pickleball in the SoCal/Arizona market. As a key function of the brand, this role works closely with the Sports Marketing, Product, Marketing and their collective Sales teams to bring our brand to life at retail. We are looking for a driven, energetic and sports- passionate sales representative to join our growing Sports Performance team. We are looking for someone who is ready to hustle, build relationships and grow the Skechers brand across one of the most exciting sports markets in the country.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Primary Categories- Core Focus

* Drive Sales and market share growth across Skechers Running, Golf and Pickleball categories within your assigned Texas territory.
* Build and manage relationships with key retail accounts, run specialty dealers, golf-tennis pro shops, and sporting goods retailers.
* Execute seasonal sell-in meetings, present product lines, and close orders that meet and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Identify and develop new account opportunities and expand distribution and brand presence in the territory.

Secondary Categories- Supporting Role

* Support sales efforts across Tennis, Walking, Soccer and Basketball categories to deliver a full Skechers portfolio to retail partners.

Brand and Field Activation

* Collaborate closely with regional tech reps to educate retail staff and athletes on Skechers product technologies, innovations and performance benefits.
* Partner with Sports Marketing team to activate brand initiatives, athlete appearances, grassroots events, and in-store experiences across the territory.
* Represent Skechers at trade shows, sporting events, clinics, and community activations throughout SoCal and Arizona.
* Champion brand storytelling and help bring the Skechers performance identify to life at the retail level.

Planning and Reporting

* Develop and manage a territory business plan aligned with regional and national sales strategies.
* Track account performance, sell-through date, and competitive insights.
* Manage seasonal order books, re-orders and product assortment recommendations for each account.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

* BA or BS degree in Business or equivalent combination of experience.
* 1+ years Marketing/Sales/Retail experience required, 2+ years preferred.
* Running, Golf, Sports or Athletic industry experience highly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Program Operations Assistant
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Program Operations Assistant will serve as an integral member of the Western Justice Center (WJC) team by supporting efficient, effective program implementation in alignment with operational policies, processes, and procedures. The role will support our conflict resolution education program teams (Restorative Schools Initiative, Training & Capacity Building), and regional trainings and initiatives ((ABCs of Conflict, Mediation Boot Camp, Peer Mediation Invitational, Circle Workshops, United Against Hate Week), as well as the day-to-day functioning of campus and office operations with consistent, quality work that upholds WJC organizational values and standards of excellence.

The Program Operations Assistant will provide administrative, logistical, and coordination support for program implementation across a variety of settings, including school sites, virtual platforms, WJC’s nonprofit campus, and other community locations as needed. Responsibilities may include coordinating program and training logistics, managing schedules, preparing agendas, planning school-site trainings, and serving as a primary point of contact for local vendors, partners, and stakeholders. Through these efforts, the Assistant will ensure that programs are organized, delivered effectively, provided with high-quality service for internal and external audiences, and are combined with strong data collection, material archiving, registration management, and cross-departmental collaboration.

**Job Responsibilities**

*General Program Administrative Support*

Provide comprehensive administrative support to the conflict resolution education team by:

* Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination for team members.
* Coordinating logistics for team meetings, events, special initiatives and special projects, including supply orders, materials prep, room reservations, agendas, minutes, follow-up, survey distribution and collection, and other logistical tasks as needed.
* Performing light editing, proofreading, and distribution of internal and external reports, proposals, presentations, and communications.
* Maintaining confidential records, databases, files, and docs (electronic and physical).
* Serving as the primary point of contact for program inquiries with exceptional customer service to internal and external stakeholders.
* Organizing the program team supply room, keeping it orderly and appropriately stocked.
* Providing electronic records management, ensuring that documents are organized, stored, aligned with naming conventions, etc.

*General Operations Administrative Support*

* Support the Office Manager as needed with the day-to-day functioning of WJC’s office and event space at the Maxwell House.
* Work with the Operations team to ensure the smooth and accurate processing, coding and submission of program team supplies, mileage and reimbursement forms, credit card reconciliations, invoices, expense reports, payments for vendors and staff, other financial documentation, and reconciling of program budgets.

*Program Event Administrative Support*

Under the direction of the project and/or team leader(s), support WJC’s signature programs and training events with comprehensive logistical planning and execution from concept design through post-event evaluation, including:

* Coordination of venue logistics, room reservations, catering, audiovisual equipment, signage, transportation, event supplies.
* Development and smooth implementation of registration systems for program participants, volunteers, and guests.
* Coordination of logistics for speakers, emcees, facilitators, panelists, photographers, videographers, vendors, and LA vs. Hate materials.
* Coordinate and lead outreach to event registrants and attendees including drafting and distributing communications related to training logistics, serving as a point of contact for the public and managing outreach emails and invitations as needed
* Partnering with communications staff on promotional materials, event communications, newsletters, and website updates.
* Coordination of event day setup, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-up.
* Preparation of participant packets, workshop materials, signage, program evaluation surveys, and printed materials.
* Collaborate with Programs and Development team to provide logistical and administrative support for volunteer engagement initiatives and recruitment strategies
* Reconcile event expenses, prepare reports, and coordinate planning for future events.

*Restorative School Initiative Administrative Support*

Provide administrative and logistical support for training programs, workshops, and any other special projects related to the Restorative Schools Initiative as needed by:

* Documenting annual training calendars designed by program team leaders, and coordinating training schedules with schools, community partners, volunteers, and facilitators.
* Managing production and distribution of training materials and program supplies.
* Maintaining volunteer and participant databases and communication records.
* Coordinating mediation mentor scheduling, onboarding, and ongoing support.
* Supporting partnerships through outreach, scheduling, logistics, and communications.
* Ensuring training locations are fully equipped with required materials and supplies.

*Grant & Data Administrative Support*

Maintain accurate records to support organizational reporting and compliance by:

* Collecting, compiling, analyzing, and reporting programs and financial data.
* Preparing program metrics, evaluation reports, and grant reporting documentation.
* Collaborating with grant staff to support grant applications and reporting requirements.
* Implementing effective systems for data collection, reporting, and program evaluation.

*Community Programs & Special Initiatives*

* Provide logistical and administrative support for the recruitment, interviewing, onboarding, and supervision of AmeriCorps VISTA membe

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.

7) Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

\*

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.

* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

3) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

Development and Administrative Coordinators (DACs) at A.M. Crawford, Inc. Monday through Friday

new_jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator (Workforce Development)
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

**The Administrative Coordinator provides program administration, participant records, attendance tracking, data management and reporting support for TCAH’s Workforce Development Department, working closely with program leadership, the Case Worker, the Job Developer, instructors and worksite supervisors. This is an administrative and compliance support role; it does not include case management, eligibility determinations or independent approval authority.**

**TCAP / Venture VI is the primary assignment (approximately 70% of workload), with ongoing YEP support (approximately 30%), including Green Teens, Green Teens Workforce, Culinary Arts and Warehouse training. Percentages are approximate annual allocations and may shift with seasonal demand, including the summer SYEP peak, and approved funding.**

**Responsibilities**

**1. Program Administration & Coordination**

* **Maintain program calendars, staff and training schedules, participant appointments and room or site reservations.**
* **Prepare agendas, sign-in sheets, correspondence and forms; record meeting notes and track action items.**
* **Coordinate logistics for orientations, workshops, trainings and hiring events; route calls, referrals and inquiries to appropriate staff.**

**2. Participant Records & File Management**

* **Schedule intake appointments, prepare packets, and collect, scan and log participant documents for Case Worker verification.**
* **Maintain complete, confidential electronic and paper files, rosters, cohort lists and exit records, shared only with authorized staff.**
* **Review files at least monthly for missing signatures, incomplete fields or expired documents and notify the assigned Case Worker.**

**3. Attendance, Data Entry & Quality Review**

* **Enter attendance and countable participation hours from source records supplied by training and worksite supervisors; flag missing or inconsistent records.**
* **Enter and update participant, service and outcome data in Salesforce and other approved systems, using source data from the Case Worker and Job Developer.**
* **Run routine quality checks for missing, duplicate or inconsistent entries and return discrepancies to the original author; gather hours and wage documents for Payroll/Accounting.**

**4. Reporting, Deadlines & Compliance Support**

* **Track and issue alerts for 30-day SNAP eligibility verification, consent renewals and 30- and 90-day retention milestones.**
* **Prepare the weekly operations dashboard and compile data for monthly KPI, quarterly and annual program reports.**
* **Organize employment verification, supportive service and reimbursement documentation for review, monitoring and audits; flag incomplete records or potential duplicate assistance.**

**5. TCAP and YEP Program Coverage**

* **TCAP / Venture VI (approximately 70%): maintain referral logs, enrollment documents, rosters, attendance, hours and retention trackers; schedule orientations, workshops, training and employer events; check employment start documentation for completeness.**
* **YEP (approximately 30%): maintain rosters, attendance and training-progress records for youth ages 14–24 and prepare YEP performance data.**
* **Seasonal SYEP: support rosters, hours, outcome records, closeout and youth event logistics (scheduled and evaluated separately from the annual allocation).**

**6. Communication & Collaboration**

* **Work with program leadership, the Case Worker, Job Developer, instructors, Benefits Access, Finance, Contracts and Compliance; refer case management or eligibility questions to appropriate staff.**
* **Route payroll, reimbursements, supportive services and record corrections to designated approvers; accuracy of case content remains with its author.**
* **Attend staff meetings and trainings, and perform other related administrative duties as assigned.**

**Qualifications**

* **High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in business administration, office administration, human services or a related field preferred. Degree preferred.**
* **At least two years of administrative, program coordination, data entry or office support experience; nonprofit, workforce or social services experience preferred.**
* **Strong organization, attention to detail and written and verbal communication skills; ability to handle confidential information responsibly.**
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); Google Workspace and Salesforce or other CRM experience preferred.**
* **Familiarity with DYCD, WIOA, SNAP E&T, OTDA or HRA requirements, and additional language skills relevant to TCAH communities, preferred.**

**Schedule and Working Conditions**

**Full-time, primarily on-site at assigned TCAH locations and partner sites, with occasional evening or weekend work for program activities and events. Summer months may bring additional workload from seasonal youth programs. Any overtime for nonexempt staff requires advance approval; all hours worked must be recorded and paid as required by law.**

**Performance Expectations**

**Performance will be reviewed against monthly file reviews, with missing or expired items flagged within 2 business days; at least 95% data-entry accuracy on supervisor spot checks; attendance and hours entered within 2 business days, and other data within 3 business days, of receipt; deadline alerts issued at least 7 days before each due date; on-time weekly dashboard and report data; records organized for monitoring and audits; and administrative effort tracked across TCAP and YEP (approximately 70% / 30%).**

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

**How We Work: AI-First by Design**
===================================

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to the same standard. Everyone at Harmonic actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building processes and automating workflows. We expect every new hire to bring curiosity about AI and a willingness to use it to work smarter, faster, and more creatively. For some roles, that means tinkering and staying open to new tools. For others, it means building entirely new systems with AI at the core. We'll be clear about what we expect for each role, and we'll give you the tools and support to get there.

**About the Team**
==================

You will report to the Director of Customer Success and work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering team leaders. Our Customer Success team delivers a world-class experience for every customer. We don't believe in one-size-fits-all. Instead, we take a deep partnership approach to help customers realize their vision and achieve meaningful business outcomes through Harmonic.

**About the Role**
==================

As a Customer Success Manager at Harmonic, you'll own the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal, for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. You'll be a trusted advisor to both executive and technical stakeholders, building the kind of deep partnerships that drive adoption, retention, and long-term value.

This role calls for someone who is comfortable operating across levels: as confident walking a security engineer through a deployment as presenting business outcomes to a CISO. You don't need a purely technical background, but you'll need to earn the trust of technical buyers and speak their language. Whether your path here was through customer success, technical account management, or solutions engineering, what matters most is that you're energized by the customer relationship and committed to their success.

You'll also play a foundational role in helping Harmonic build the playbooks, processes, and metrics that will scale with us as we grow.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, owning relationships at both the executive and technical level.
* Lead the full customer lifecycle from onboarding and deployment through adoption, renewal, and expansion.
* Run technical onboardings alongside customer security and IT teams: configuring integrations, walking through data flows, and ensuring Harmonic is embedded into the customer's environment correctly.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) that connect product telemetry to measurable business outcomes and executive priorities.
* Proactively monitor customer health signals, identify risk early, and drive mitigation plans before issues escalate.
* Champion the voice of the customer internally, translating technical and strategic feedback into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
* Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities, building the case for upsell and identifying new stakeholders and use cases.
* Contribute to the CS playbook: help build the processes, tooling, and metrics that define how Harmonic delivers value at scale.

new_jobs.description:
### **Why We Need You**

Defense primes and top federal integrators run their proposals on GovEagle inside FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud, from our web app, Word, and SharePoint. We've grown 5x in revenue and 10x in daily users, and our customers expect answers in minutes: we hold ourselves to a first reply within 15 minutes. Fast, reliable help and real adoption are why customers renew and refer their peers.

We're adding a Customer Success Manager to own a book of accounts from kickoff through renewal. You'll make sure every team that buys GovEagle actually uses it: run onboarding and trainings, keep accounts healthy, and lead renewal and expansion conversations alongside sales. We want someone who holds a high bar for speed and follow-through, builds the playbooks the next CSM will use, and is comfortable creating urgency when a rollout stalls.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own a book of accounts end to end.** Kickoff, onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion, with a clear plan for every account.
* **Respond fast.** First reply to customer messages in Teams and email within 15 minutes during business hours; resolve common issues the same day.
* **Run onboarding and trainings.** Coordinate SharePoint and SSO setup with customer IT teams, provision users, and lead trainings and office hours for proposal teams.
* **Drive renewals.** Track each account's goals, push for decisions, and partner with sales on renewal and expansion conversations.
* **Watch account health.** Use usage data to spot risk early and act on it long before renewal.
* **Build the playbooks.** Onboarding checklists, training decks, help articles, and release notes that make every next account faster.
* **Escalate cleanly.** Reproduce issues, write tickets engineers can act on right away, and close the loop with the customer.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Bring patterns in feedback and requests back to product and engineering.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 2 to 5 years in customer success, account management, or implementation at a B2B software company, ideally a fast-growing startup. Or proposal, capture, or BD experience at a government contractor and a strong pull toward software.
* A track record of owning outcomes: renewals, adoption, or pilots you drove to a result.
* Fast and organized: you answer quickly, follow up without being asked, and keep every commitment visible.
* Comfortable with direct conversations: you can push a customer on timelines, usage, and next steps while keeping the relationship strong.
* A clear communicator who can run a training for a room of proposal managers.
* Tech-savvy and quick with new tools; Microsoft 365 and SharePoint experience is a plus.
* You use AI tools every day to work faster, and you know where not to trust them.
* U.S. citizen (required): our customers work in environments subject to export controls.
* Based in New York City and able to work in our office four days a week, or based in the Washington, DC area and working remotely with occasional travel to New York and customer sites.

**Nice to have:** Government contracting, proposal management (APMP), or defense experience; experience at a YC or other venture-backed startup. No GovCon background needed; we'll teach you the domain.

### **What success looks like in your first 90 days**

* **30 days:** Answering customer inbound alongside the team, running your first trainings, and shadowing renewals.
* **60 days:** You own a book of accounts and have run an onboarding end to end; your first playbook is live.
* **90 days:** Your accounts hit their renewal milestones on time, most questions are resolved without engineering, and every account has a health review on the calendar.

### **About GovEagle**

GovEagle's AI platform helps government contractors win more work. Our AI agents dramatically reduce RFP response times by helping teams shred requirements, build compliance matrices, deliver exhaustive outlines, and draft compelling narratives. We're well capitalized ($10M from Y Combinator, Strategic Cyber Ventures, Sorenson Capital, and others) and based in NYC. Benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); generous PTO.

**How we hire:** a founder conversation, a customer scenario exercise (a short training walkthrough and a few real, anonymized customer messages), and a half-day onsite in New York. About two weeks. Don't meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

Compensation Range: $90K - $130K

new_jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Development Assistant is responsible for supporting the Development Department at large at Planned Parenthood of Greater New York. This role will report to the Director, Annual Giving and be responsible for many diverse administrative tasks across Development teams such as the acknowledgement letter process, supporting the annual fund and direct mail programs. The Development Assistant will do equal work across the Special Events and Institutional Funding teams with event management, meeting coordination, data entry, and system-building work.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Create a unified gift acknowledgement process with built-in quality control processes. This includes acknowledgement letters signed by the CEO, Honor/Memorial gift acknowledgements and cards, Special Event tickets and contribution acknowledgements, and Institutional Funding acknowledgements.
* Provide timely and reader-friendly notifications of gifts to internal and external stakeholders.
* Support the planning and execution of the Annual Campaign each fall, including the creation, merging, and mailing of solicitation materials.
* Support maintaining systems built around the President’s Circle (PC) donor affinity group, and other administrative and organizational tasks.
* Assist with administrative tasks pre-and-post event, as well day-of onsite work at Special Events across NY State.

* Provide administrative support to Institutional Funding on a project basis, including systems building, data entry, acknowledgement letters, and gift tracking.

**REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES**

* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills with the ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple tasks and responsibilities.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to quickly learn organizational tone and voice.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to participate in some evening and weekend events as needed.
* Ability to work well with others.
* An understanding of the role that racial inequity plays in our society and its impact on healthcare systems and institutions.
* A basic understanding of how race dynamics impact relationships and organizational culture, and a willingness to learn about how to successfully intervene in problematic dynamics and deepen a racial equity approach within an organization, team, service, program, or campaign.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Requires sitting for long periods of time. Periodic standing, walking, and bending. Requires lifting of up to 15 pounds. Visual acuity sufficient to perform frequent work on a computer screen and review printed reports and other materials. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets. Requires the ability to hear and to communicate orally with others.

**PPGNY's benefits package includes:**

Generous PTO and holiday schedule

Medical, dental and vision coverage options for you and eligible dependents

FSA, HSA, Commuter pre-tax reimbursement funds

Short- and Long-Term Disability, Free Basic Life and AD&D

401(k) Retirement Plan with Safe Harbor contributions after 1 year of employment

**All positions at PPGNY require:**

Proof of immunization or immunity to certain communicable diseases (including influenza during the flu season and Covid-19) and testing for tuberculosis. These certifications are required by the NYC DOHMH Health Code, NYSDOH and OSHA.

Planned Parenthood of Greater New York (PPGNY) is a leading provider, educator, and advocate of sexual and reproductive health care in New York State. PPGNY is proud to provide a wide-range of family planning services at our brick-and-mortar health centers and mobile care units. We care for everyone regardless of their immigration status, zip code or ability to pay. As a voice for reproductive freedom, PPGNY supports legislation and policies that ensure all New Yorkers have access to the full range of reproductive health care and education.

At PPGNY, we provide the absolute best care to our patients and our communities through innovative health care delivery and education programming. **Business Unit/Department:** Southeast

**FLSA Classification:** Non-Exempt

**About Loenbro**

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

  

**At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose.** Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

  

**Job Summary**

The Field Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and completion of field-based projects. This role serves as a critical liaison between project managers, field personnel, subcontractors, clients, and vendors to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with company quality standards.

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

  

**Project Coordination**

* Assist Project Managers with the planning, scheduling, and execution of field projects.
* Coordinate project activities, resources, equipment, and personnel.
* Monitor project schedules and communicate progress updates to stakeholders.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Support project startups, mobilization, and closeout activities.

**Field Operations Support**

* Conduct site visits to monitor project progress and ensure compliance with project specifications.
* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, and vendors to maintain workflow efficiency.
* Ensure field activities are completed in accordance with safety regulations and company procedures.
* Assist with resolving field-related issues and identifying corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of site activities, labor hours, and equipment utilization.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain project documentation including daily reports, schedules, change orders, permits, and project logs.
* Track project costs, purchase orders, and invoices.
* Generate status reports for project managers and leadership teams.
* Ensure all project records are organized and updated throughout the project lifecycle.

**Client & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a point of contact for customers, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Facilitate project meetings and document meeting minutes and action items.
* Communicate schedule changes, project updates, and field conditions to stakeholders.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients and project partners.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Assist with job hazard analyses, site inspections, and safety audits.
* Verify compliance with contractual requirements, permits, and regulatory standards.
* Report and document incidents, near misses, and safety concerns.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with project management software is preferred.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in fast-paced field environments.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

  

* Associate's degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent field experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

* 2+ years of project coordination, construction, industrial, utilities, telecommunications, or related field experience preferred.
* Experience supporting field operations and managing project documentation.
* Familiarity with subcontractor coordination and project scheduling.

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

**Work Environment:**

  

* Ability to travel to project sites as needed.
* Ability to work both in office and field environments.
* Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to walk construction or industrial sites and work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

*This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.*

**Benefits**

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Life and disability insurance
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

*Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.*

### **About us and why we’re hiring...**

RoadSync is revolutionizing the logistics industry with intelligent, simple, and innovative financial solutions. Our digital platform streamlines payment processes for warehouses, carriers, brokers, and repair/tow operators, dramatically reducing processing time and maximizing revenue collection.

We are seeking an Implementation Specialist to onboard and activate new customers. You’ll own the early customer journey for your assigned accounts—from kickoff to first transaction to full ramp—and ensure every customer is actively using the product, not just set up.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

##### **Onboarding & Activation**

* Manage onboarding for your assigned customers from deal close through first transaction, aiming to complete onboarding within the month.
* This position may require travel (35%) to see clients.
* Keep implementations moving by identifying blockers early, sequencing setup steps, and hitting activation milestones.
* Guide customers through configuration, training, and their first live transactions.
* Validate business requirements upfront so each implementation is scoped correctly.

##### **Ramp & Feature Adoption**

* Track customer transaction volume weekly and flag accounts falling behind the expected ramp.
* Drive adoption of revenue-generating features, including hardware and special promotions.
* Use implementation playbooks to move customers from basic setup to full platform use.

##### **Retention & Transition**

* Monitor customer health in your portfolio and raise at-risk accounts early.
* Hand off customers to Account Management with documented notes: active transactions, features adopted, and next steps.
* Work with the Account Management team to keep transitions warm and customers engaged after handoff.

##### **Process & Knowledge Sharing**

* Follow and contribute to documented processes, playbooks, and knowledge base articles.
* Meet team KPIs and SLAs, and take coaching and feedback from your manager.
* Suggest process improvements and share them with your manager and Revenue Operations.

##### **Communication & Collaboration**

* Give your manager regular updates on onboarding progress and at-risk accounts.
* Share clear, data-backed feedback with Product, RevOps, and Support when you see activation blockers or process friction.
* Escalate issues with context and a recommended path forward.

#### **Qualifications**

##### **Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in customer success, implementation, or onboarding within a SaaS or payments technology environment.
* Experience managing customer onboarding or implementation projects focused on time-to-value and activation.
* Ability to review data, spot at-risk accounts, and act on what you find.
* Comfortable using a CRM (HubSpot a plus) for tracking customers, health, and reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable working with customers and cross-functional teams.

##### **Preferred**

* Experience in logistics, payments, or fleet services.
* Familiarity with merchant processing, transaction-based revenue, or platform fee models.
* Experience deploying hardware (payment terminals, mobile devices) during onboarding.
* Experience contributing to implementation playbooks, knowledge bases, or customer training.

#### **Why you’ll love it here...**

RoadSync is a team of passionate professionals who care deeply about what we do and bring our best every day. We value being a diverse and inclusive team and company. In addition to joining an innovative and passionate team, you will get:

* Competitive compensation package and company equity awarded on day 1!

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits, with premiums paid for employees
* Exposure to the inner workings of a growing company, including open, transparent communication within our team. You will know what is happening and why it matters.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, height, weight, veteran status, military obligations, pregnancy, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. **Duties and Responsibilities**

**Overview**
  
Loyola University Chicago’s School of Law is a student-focused Law Center inspired by the Jesuit tradition of academic excellence, intellectual openness, and service to others. Learn more by visiting our website: **https://www.luc.edu/law/**

Led by the School of Law, the Holistic Immigration Hub (HIH) Pilot is designed to harness Loyola’s collaborative spirit and cross-disciplinary approach to recognize and restore the fundamental dignity of migrants in society and before the law. Leveraging powerful partnerships amongst the School of Law, Stritch School of Medicine, Parkinson School of Health Sciences and Public Health, and the Schools of Education and Social Work, the HIH Pilot advances novel legal pedagogy, interdisciplinary clinical training, and innovative research to develop a new generation of immigration lawyers, serve migrant children and families, and propel Loyola’s reputation as a leader in immigrant justice guided by Jesuit values.

This collaborative effort will achieve three goals:

* **Leadership:** Create a pipeline of the next generation of leaders and professionals.
* **Service:** Support Chicago community organizations and the children and families they serve.
* **Innovation:** Catalyze visionary, systemic change.
  

The Innovation Incubator is a component of the HIH Pilot designed to catalyze visionary systemic change in the immigration system utilizing interdisciplinary methods. Operationally, the Incubator functions as an integral partner of the Immigration Law Lab and the Immigration and Human Rights Clinic, also components of the HIH Pilot.

In the law school, the Incubator presents a unique opportunity for students to dive deeply into complex immigration issues while meeting the needs of our community collaborators through a technical assistance implementation model.

**Position Summary**

As part of the HIH Pilot, the Program Coordinator will work alongside the HIH Pilot team to launch the Innovation Incubator. The Program Coordinator will have primary responsibility for coordination of the Incubator through a technical assistance model. Specifically, the Program Coordinator will engage in developing and maintaining collaborative relationships with organizational stakeholders (“collaborators”) involved in the Innovation Incubator; develop internal and external protocols for tracking innovation requests and outcome documents; support faculty and staff engaging in outreach and site visits with Loyola’s organizational collaborators; track and analyze trends and other data in the assistance provided to Loyola collaborators; otherwise work collaboratively to launch this innovative new programming.

All Staff within the School of Law report to the Associate Dean for Administration. In addition, Staff are expected to work collaboratively to advance the goals of the HIH Pilot as outlined above and the strategic priorities established by the HIH Pilot. Staff are accountable to those responsible for overseeing the Pilot’s day-to-day operations.

*The position is grant-funded for a period of 2 years or as long as funds are available.*
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:**

In close collaboration with the leader of the Immigration clinic, the Program Coordinator will engage in the following duties:

* Creating the intake, management, and tracking system(s) for thematic technical assistance requests (innovation requests) handled by the Immigration Innovation Incubator.
* Providing technical and logistical support for Loyola Students from across disciplines in the efforts to respond to innovation requests.
* Developing protocols for accepting and tracking innovation requests and outcome documents;
* Identifying data points / metrics to capture and track to meaningfully illustrate impact of interdisciplinary research and outcome documents.

new_jobs.description:
**Part Time Sales Development Representative**

**Chicago, IL (Hybrid: Remote Admin / In-Person Meetings)**

**COMPANY:** Novel Ventures is a startup studio building impact-driven ventures at the intersection of technology and human flourishing. Since 2021, we have combined capital and the expertise of a centralized team of builders to tackle some of the world’s most challenging issues.

Our latest venture, Firefli Fitness, is a fitness rewards platform that turns daily movement (like steps, sleep, and workouts) into real-world rewards.

**THE ROLE:** We are looking for a passionate, driven Sales Representative to generate new business for Firefli Fitness. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification to closing deals and nurturing long-term relationships. Because you’re representing a brand built around healthy habits, your genuine enthusiasm for fitness and wellness will help you authentically connect with partners and clients.

This is a flexible hybrid role: you will work from home for day-to-day prospecting, outreach, and administrative tasks, while attending occasional in-person business meetings and local fitness/wellness events in the Chicago area as needed.

Hourly rate up to $30/hr + performance-based commission structure.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Generate leads, build relationships, and source new strategic partners across the fitness, wellness, and corporate health spaces.
* Maintain an organized, up-to-date pipeline in the CRM and track progress against targets.
* Clearly and authentically communicate Firefli’s value proposition and product features to prospective clients, leveraging your understanding of health and fitness habits.
* Report to leadership with weekly, monthly, and quarterly results.
* Share insights and feedback from prospects, along with emerging fitness and wellness trends, to inform product and go-to-market improvements.
* Experiment with new outreach methods (creative campaigns, local fitness events, studio/brand partnerships) to drive awareness and engagement.

**THE PERFECT CANDIDATE:**

* You are based in the Greater Chicago area and available to attend occasional in-person business meetings.
* You have a genuine passion for fitness, health, and wellness, and stay up to date on industry trends, wearable tech, or active lifestyle brands.
* You have a BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience.
* You have at least 1 year of sales experience (experience in the fitness, wellness, or health-tech space is a strong plus).
* You thrive in a startup environment: self-starter, resourceful, and comfortable with ambiguity.
* You are an exceptional communicator, both written and verbal.
* You are proficient with technology (CRM tools, LinkedIn, Google Workspace).
* You’re curious and eager to learn, willing to test new approaches and iterate quickly.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Illinois Policy Institute is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented **Executive Assistant** to provide administrative and operational support to the CEO. Key responsibilities include managing the CEO’s email inbox, effectively managing the CEO’s calendar and meetings, communicating sensitive information in a timely manner, and coordinating administrative priorities.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally dependable, self-motivated, and accountable. They have the ability to work independently and consistently follow through on tasks and responsibilities with minimal supervision. This role requires strong communication and organizational skills, discretion while handling confidential information, and the ability to anticipate needs and manage competing priorities.

**Position Details**

Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

Reports to: CEO

Department: Executive

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the CEO’s email inbox, including reviewing, prioritizing, drafting, and routing correspondence.
* Evaluate and prioritize messages and requests for the CEO’s time or attention, ensuring all matters are addressed in a timely and efficient manner.
* Coordinate meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.
* Prepare, draft, and proofread meeting materials, presentations, reports, and other executive documents.
* Gather, organize, and synthesize information to support the CEO’s priorities and decision-making.
* Communicate sensitive and time-sensitive information with accuracy and discretion.
* Attend meetings as needed, take accurate minutes, and track follow-up.
* Maintain organized records, files, and administrative systems.
* Partner with the Development team to coordinate donor meetings and events for the CEO.
* Greet and assist the CEO’s office visitors, providing a professional and welcoming experience.
* Assist with front desk responsibilities and general administrative needs as necessary.
* Support special projects and other executive priorities as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* At least two years of administrative experience, preferably in a nonprofit setting or executive support role.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Gmail and Google Calendar.
* Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks.
* Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential information.
* Proactive problem-solving skills with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.
* Commitment to the mission of Illinois Policy Institute and an interest in free-market principles and individual liberty.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The base salary range for this position is $50,000–$70,000, commensurate with experience.

Benefits include medical and dental insurance with employer contributions, a 401(k) plan, flexible spending benefits, paid vacation, and sick leave.

**Location & Work Arrangement**

The Executive Assistant will be based in our Chicago office and is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement in accordance with Illinois Policy Institute’s hybrid work policy. However, the role requires flexibility to work on-site additional days during the week as needed to support the CEO, coordinate meetings, and accommodate organizational priorities.

While we thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, we are only able to contact those to whom we can offer an interview. Only direct applications will be considered. No phone calls, please.

**Apply here**
